# AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/generators/gen_culture_merges.py - do not edit manually.

# ---- german ----

# Country scope: the candidate (or the running merge's starter). The german result's average standard of
# living, pop-weighted, over its pops in the sphere's part of the core parts' homeland states (a state
# that is the homeland of several counts once). Sets te_cm_sg_ref, 0 when the result has no pops there.
# The reference an optional part is held against once no core part has a figure left; run only then.
te_cmg_german_result_sol = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = te_cm_starter
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rsolw value = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { te_cm_in_sphere = yes }
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:north_german }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:south_german }
				}
			}
			every_scope_pop = {
				limit = { culture = cu:cm_german }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops add = total_size }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rsolw add = { value = standard_of_living multiply = total_size } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops >= 1 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = te_cm_sg_ref
			value = {
				value = local_var:te_cm_sg_rsolw
				divide = local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_german, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_german_<culture>, over the core range plus that part; with no core figure left, against the
# result's (walked only then, and only while an optional part has not switched, joined or not: the gate of a part
# that has joined must keep following the result, or one dip would freeze it for good).
te_cmg_census_german_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_german } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = german CULTURE = north_german RESULT = cm_german TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_south_german } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = german CULTURE = south_german RESULT = cm_german TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_alemannic } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = german CULTURE = alemannic RESULT = cm_german TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_east_german } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = german CULTURE = east_german RESULT = cm_german TIER = 1 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_german_north_german_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = german CULTURE = north_german }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_german_north_german_measured = yes
				te_cmg_german_north_german_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_german_south_german_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = german CULTURE = south_german }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_german_south_german_measured = yes
				te_cmg_german_south_german_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 2 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_german } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_german value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_german = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_german value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_german value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_ref value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:te_cm_sg_n = 0
			local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_alemannic }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_east_german }
			}
		}
		te_cmg_german_result_sol = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_alemannic } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = german CULTURE = alemannic }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_east_german } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = german CULTURE = east_german }
	}
	te_cmg_german_settle = yes
}

# Country scope. Joins every part of the german merge that can join now and isn't waiting on a
# vanilla entry: when the merge starts, and each census while its starter holds it. Nothing joins once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33).
te_cmg_german_join_ready = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_german } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_german_north_german_can_join = yes
				NOT = { te_cmg_german_north_german_waiting = yes }
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = german CULTURE = north_german INDEX = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_german_south_german_can_join = yes
				NOT = { te_cmg_german_south_german_waiting = yes }
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = german CULTURE = south_german INDEX = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_german_alemannic_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = german CULTURE = alemannic INDEX = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_german_east_german_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = german CULTURE = east_german INDEX = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: the button's effect. The country starts the german merge and brings in the parts it
# holds that qualify now. Only an idle merge starts: a second click on the same day finds it running.
te_cmg_start_german = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 2 } }
		te_cm_start_merge = { MERGE = german RESULT = cm_german }
		te_cmg_german_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Country scope: the tail of te_cmg_census_german_country, run after the part gates are fresh.
# 1. A wait year, while the merge could start but a vanilla entry on a core part is open in any country (once a census,
#    up to te_cm_wait_cap_years).
# 2. The journal entry's net: an idle merge's candidate that can start, or a running merge's starter,
#    gets the entry back if it holds neither the active nor the inactive record (a rule switched off and on
#    prunes the inactive ones; a concluded entry is gone). It reads the entry's own gate and never adds one for
#    a complete merge, whose finished entry is its end. Merge mechanics never key on the entry.
# 3. Late joins: the starter of a running or complete merge brings in every part that now qualifies.
te_cmg_german_settle = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			te_cmg_german_start_basics = yes
			OR = {
				any_country = {
					has_journal_entry = je_german_unification_idea
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_german } }
			set_variable = { name = te_cm_wait_years_german value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_wait_years_german < te_cm_wait_cap_years }
			change_variable = { name = te_cm_wait_years_german add = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			te_cm_system_enabled = yes
			NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_te_cm_german }
			NOT = { has_inactive_journal_entry = je_te_cm_german }
			OR = {
				te_cmg_german_can_start = yes
				AND = {
					global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 1
					te_cmg_german_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
		}
		add_journal_entry = { type = je_te_cm_german }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_german_is_starter = yes }
		te_cmg_german_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_german = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_german_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_german_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_german }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_german = {
			te_cmg_census_german_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: the button's effect. The country starts the italian merge and brings in the parts it
# holds that qualify now. Only an idle merge starts: a second click on the same day finds it running.
# Not once its result has switched into a wider culture (R36): that culture has gone, and a start would make it a
# primary culture again. The button's can_start says so too; this is the guard behind it.
te_cmg_start_italian = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_italian ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_italian ?= 2 }
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_italian }
		}
		te_cm_start_merge = { MERGE = italian RESULT = cm_italian }
		te_cmg_italian_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# ---- scandinavian ----

# Country scope: the candidate (or the running merge's starter). The scandinavian result's average standard of
# living, pop-weighted, over its pops in the sphere's part of the core parts' homeland states (a state
# that is the homeland of several counts once). Sets te_cm_sg_ref, 0 when the result has no pops there.
# The reference an optional part is held against once no core part has a figure left; run only then.
te_cmg_scandinavian_result_sol = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = te_cm_starter
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rsolw value = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { te_cm_in_sphere = yes }
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:swedish }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:danish }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:norwegian }
				}
			}
			every_scope_pop = {
				limit = { culture = cu:cm_scandinavian }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops add = total_size }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rsolw add = { value = standard_of_living multiply = total_size } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops >= 1 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = te_cm_sg_ref
			value = {
				value = local_var:te_cm_sg_rsolw
				divide = local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_scandinavian, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_scandinavian_<culture>, over the core range plus that part; with no core figure left, against the
# result's (walked only then, and only while an optional part has not switched, joined or not: the gate of a part
# that has joined must keep following the result, or one dip would freeze it for good).

	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_swedish } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = scandinavian CULTURE = swedish RESULT = cm_scandinavian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_danish } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = scandinavian CULTURE = danish RESULT = cm_scandinavian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_norwegian } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = scandinavian CULTURE = norwegian RESULT = cm_scandinavian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_icelandic } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = scandinavian CULTURE = icelandic RESULT = cm_scandinavian TIER = 1 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_scandinavian_swedish_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = scandinavian CULTURE = swedish }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_scandinavian_swedish_measured = yes
				te_cmg_scandinavian_swedish_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_scandinavian_danish_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = scandinavian CULTURE = danish }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_scandinavian_danish_measured = yes
				te_cmg_scandinavian_danish_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_scandinavian_norwegian_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = scandinavian CULTURE = norwegian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_scandinavian_norwegian_measured = yes
				te_cmg_scandinavian_norwegian_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 3 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_scandinavian } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_scandinavian value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_scandinavian = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_scandinavian value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_scandinavian value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_ref value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:te_cm_sg_n = 0
			local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_icelandic }
			}
		}
		te_cmg_scandinavian_result_sol = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_icelandic } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = scandinavian CULTURE = icelandic }
	}
	te_cmg_scandinavian_settle = yes
}

# Country scope. Joins every part of the scandinavian merge that can join now and isn't waiting on a
# vanilla entry: when the merge starts, and each census while its starter holds it. Nothing joins once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33).
te_cmg_scandinavian_join_ready = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_scandinavian } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_scandinavian_swedish_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = scandinavian CULTURE = swedish INDEX = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_scandinavian_danish_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = scandinavian CULTURE = danish INDEX = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_scandinavian_norwegian_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = scandinavian CULTURE = norwegian INDEX = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_scandinavian_icelandic_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = scandinavian CULTURE = icelandic INDEX = 3 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: the button's effect. The country starts the scandinavian merge and brings in the parts it
# holds that qualify now. Only an idle merge starts: a second click on the same day finds it running.
te_cmg_start_scandinavian = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_scandinavian ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_scandinavian ?= 2 } }
		te_cm_start_merge = { MERGE = scandinavian RESULT = cm_scandinavian }
		te_cmg_scandinavian_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Country scope: the tail of te_cmg_census_scandinavian_country, run after the part gates are fresh.
# 1. A wait year, while the merge could start but a vanilla entry on a core part is open in any country (once a census,
#    up to te_cm_wait_cap_years).
# 2. The journal entry's net: an idle merge's candidate that can start, or a running merge's starter,
#    gets the entry back if it holds neither the active nor the inactive record (a rule switched off and on
#    prunes the inactive ones; a concluded entry is gone). It reads the entry's own gate and never adds one for
#    a complete merge, whose finished entry is its end. Merge mechanics never key on the entry.
# 3. Late joins: the starter of a running or complete merge brings in every part that now qualifies.
te_cmg_scandinavian_settle = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			te_cm_system_enabled = yes
			NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_te_cm_scandinavian }
			NOT = { has_inactive_journal_entry = je_te_cm_scandinavian }
			OR = {
				te_cmg_scandinavian_can_start = yes
				AND = {
					global_var:te_cm_state_scandinavian ?= 1
					te_cmg_scandinavian_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
		}
		add_journal_entry = { type = je_te_cm_scandinavian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_scandinavian_is_starter = yes }
		te_cmg_scandinavian_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_scandinavian = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_scandinavian ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_scandinavian ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_scandinavian_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_scandinavian_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_scandinavian }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_scandinavian = {
			te_cmg_census_scandinavian_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- east_slavic ----

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_east_slavic, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_east_slavic_<culture>, over the core range plus that part; with no core figure left, against the
# result's (walked only then, and only while an optional part has not switched, joined or not: the gate of a part
# that has joined must keep following the result, or one dip would freeze it for good).
te_cmg_census_east_slavic_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_russian } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = east_slavic CULTURE = russian RESULT = cm_east_slavic TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ukrainian } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = east_slavic CULTURE = ukrainian RESULT = cm_east_slavic TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_byelorussian } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = east_slavic CULTURE = byelorussian RESULT = cm_east_slavic TIER = 1 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_east_slavic_russian_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = east_slavic CULTURE = russian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_east_slavic_russian_measured = yes
				te_cmg_east_slavic_russian_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_east_slavic_ukrainian_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = east_slavic CULTURE = ukrainian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_east_slavic_ukrainian_measured = yes
				te_cmg_east_slavic_ukrainian_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_east_slavic_byelorussian_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = east_slavic CULTURE = byelorussian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_east_slavic_byelorussian_measured = yes
				te_cmg_east_slavic_byelorussian_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 3 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_east_slavic } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_east_slavic value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_east_slavic = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_east_slavic value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_east_slavic value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	te_cmg_east_slavic_settle = yes
}

# Country scope. Joins every part of the east_slavic merge that can join now and isn't waiting on a
# vanilla entry: when the merge starts, and each census while its starter holds it. Nothing joins once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33).
te_cmg_east_slavic_join_ready = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_east_slavic } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_east_slavic_russian_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = east_slavic CULTURE = russian INDEX = 4 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_east_slavic_ukrainian_can_join = yes
				NOT = { te_cmg_east_slavic_ukrainian_waiting = yes }
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = east_slavic CULTURE = ukrainian INDEX = 4 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_east_slavic_byelorussian_can_join = yes
				NOT = { te_cmg_east_slavic_byelorussian_waiting = yes }
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = east_slavic CULTURE = byelorussian INDEX = 4 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: the button's effect. The country starts the east_slavic merge and brings in the parts it
# holds that qualify now. Only an idle merge starts: a second click on the same day finds it running.
# Not once its result has switched into a wider culture (R36): that culture has gone, and a start would make it a
# primary culture again. The button's can_start says so too; this is the guard behind it.
te_cmg_start_east_slavic = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_east_slavic ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_east_slavic ?= 2 }
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_east_slavic }
		}
		te_cm_start_merge = { MERGE = east_slavic RESULT = cm_east_slavic }
		te_cmg_east_slavic_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Country scope: the tail of te_cmg_census_east_slavic_country, run after the part gates are fresh.
# 1. A wait year, while the merge could start but a vanilla entry on a core part is open in any country (once a census,
#    up to te_cm_wait_cap_years).
# 2. The journal entry's net: an idle merge's candidate that can start, or a running merge's starter,
#    gets the entry back if it holds neither the active nor the inactive record (a rule switched off and on
#    prunes the inactive ones; a concluded entry is gone). It reads the entry's own gate and never adds one for
#    a complete merge, whose finished entry is its end. Merge mechanics never key on the entry.
# 3. Late joins: the starter of a running or complete merge brings in every part that now qualifies.
te_cmg_east_slavic_settle = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			te_cmg_east_slavic_start_basics = yes
			OR = {
				any_country = {
					has_journal_entry = je_ukraine_cultural_renaissance
				}
				any_country = {
					has_journal_entry = je_belarus_cultural_renaissance
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_east_slavic } }
			set_variable = { name = te_cm_wait_years_east_slavic value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_wait_years_east_slavic < te_cm_wait_cap_years }
			change_variable = { name = te_cm_wait_years_east_slavic add = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			te_cm_system_enabled = yes
			NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_te_cm_east_slavic }
			NOT = { has_inactive_journal_entry = je_te_cm_east_slavic }
			OR = {
				te_cmg_east_slavic_can_start = yes
				AND = {
					global_var:te_cm_state_east_slavic ?= 1
					te_cmg_east_slavic_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
		}
		add_journal_entry = { type = je_te_cm_east_slavic }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_east_slavic_is_starter = yes }
		te_cmg_east_slavic_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_east_slavic = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_east_slavic ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_east_slavic ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_east_slavic_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_east_slavic_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_east_slavic }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_east_slavic = {
			te_cmg_census_east_slavic_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- yugoslav ----

# Country scope: the candidate (or the running merge's starter). The yugoslav result's average standard of
# living, pop-weighted, over its pops in the sphere's part of the core parts' homeland states (a state
# that is the homeland of several counts once). Sets te_cm_sg_ref, 0 when the result has no pops there.
# The reference an optional part is held against once no core part has a figure left; run only then.
te_cmg_yugoslav_result_sol = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = te_cm_starter
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rsolw value = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { te_cm_in_sphere = yes }
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:serb }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:croat }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:bosniak }
				}
			}
			every_scope_pop = {
				limit = { culture = cu:cm_yugoslav }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops add = total_size }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rsolw add = { value = standard_of_living multiply = total_size } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops >= 1 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = te_cm_sg_ref
			value = {
				value = local_var:te_cm_sg_rsolw
				divide = local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_yugoslav, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_yugoslav_<culture>, over the core range plus that part; with no core figure left, against the
# result's (walked only then, and only while an optional part has not switched, joined or not: the gate of a part
# that has joined must keep following the result, or one dip would freeze it for good).
te_cmg_census_yugoslav_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_serb } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = yugoslav CULTURE = serb RESULT = cm_yugoslav TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_croat } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = yugoslav CULTURE = croat RESULT = cm_yugoslav TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bosniak } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = yugoslav CULTURE = bosniak RESULT = cm_yugoslav TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_slovene } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = yugoslav CULTURE = slovene RESULT = cm_yugoslav TIER = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bulgarian } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = yugoslav CULTURE = bulgarian RESULT = cm_yugoslav TIER = 3 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_yugoslav_serb_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = yugoslav CULTURE = serb }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_yugoslav_serb_measured = yes
				te_cmg_yugoslav_serb_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_yugoslav_croat_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = yugoslav CULTURE = croat }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_yugoslav_croat_measured = yes
				te_cmg_yugoslav_croat_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_yugoslav_bosniak_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = yugoslav CULTURE = bosniak }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_yugoslav_bosniak_measured = yes
				te_cmg_yugoslav_bosniak_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 3 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_yugoslav } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_yugoslav value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_yugoslav = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_yugoslav value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_yugoslav value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_ref value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:te_cm_sg_n = 0
			local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_slovene }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bulgarian }
			}
		}
		te_cmg_yugoslav_result_sol = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_slovene } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = yugoslav CULTURE = slovene }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bulgarian } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = yugoslav CULTURE = bulgarian }
	}
	te_cmg_yugoslav_settle = yes
}

# Country scope. Joins every part of the yugoslav merge that can join now and isn't waiting on a
# vanilla entry: when the merge starts, and each census while its starter holds it. Nothing joins once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33).
te_cmg_yugoslav_join_ready = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_yugoslav } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_yugoslav_serb_can_join = yes
				NOT = { te_cmg_yugoslav_serb_waiting = yes }
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = yugoslav CULTURE = serb INDEX = 5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_yugoslav_croat_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = yugoslav CULTURE = croat INDEX = 5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_yugoslav_bosniak_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = yugoslav CULTURE = bosniak INDEX = 5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_yugoslav_slovene_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = yugoslav CULTURE = slovene INDEX = 5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_yugoslav_bulgarian_can_join = yes
				NOT = { te_cmg_yugoslav_bulgarian_waiting = yes }
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = yugoslav CULTURE = bulgarian INDEX = 5 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: the button's effect. The country starts the yugoslav merge and brings in the parts it
# holds that qualify now. Only an idle merge starts: a second click on the same day finds it running.
# Not once its result has switched into a wider culture (R36): that culture has gone, and a start would make it a
# primary culture again. The button's can_start says so too; this is the guard behind it.
te_cmg_start_yugoslav = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_yugoslav ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_yugoslav ?= 2 }
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_yugoslav }
		}
		te_cm_start_merge = { MERGE = yugoslav RESULT = cm_yugoslav }
		te_cmg_yugoslav_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Country scope: the tail of te_cmg_census_yugoslav_country, run after the part gates are fresh.
# 1. A wait year, while the merge could start but a vanilla entry on a core part is open in any country (once a census,
#    up to te_cm_wait_cap_years).
# 2. The journal entry's net: an idle merge's candidate that can start, or a running merge's starter,
#    gets the entry back if it holds neither the active nor the inactive record (a rule switched off and on
#    prunes the inactive ones; a concluded entry is gone). It reads the entry's own gate and never adds one for
#    a complete merge, whose finished entry is its end. Merge mechanics never key on the entry.
# 3. Late joins: the starter of a running or complete merge brings in every part that now qualifies.
te_cmg_yugoslav_settle = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			te_cmg_yugoslav_start_basics = yes
			OR = {
				any_country = {
					has_journal_entry = je_the_balkan_league
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_yugoslav } }
			set_variable = { name = te_cm_wait_years_yugoslav value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_wait_years_yugoslav < te_cm_wait_cap_years }
			change_variable = { name = te_cm_wait_years_yugoslav add = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			te_cm_system_enabled = yes
			NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_te_cm_yugoslav }
			NOT = { has_inactive_journal_entry = je_te_cm_yugoslav }
			OR = {
				te_cmg_yugoslav_can_start = yes
				AND = {
					global_var:te_cm_state_yugoslav ?= 1
					te_cmg_yugoslav_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
		}
		add_journal_entry = { type = je_te_cm_yugoslav }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_yugoslav_is_starter = yes }
		te_cmg_yugoslav_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_yugoslav = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_yugoslav ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_yugoslav ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_yugoslav_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_yugoslav_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_yugoslav }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_yugoslav = {
			te_cmg_census_yugoslav_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- czechoslovak ----

# Country scope: the candidate (or the running merge's starter). The czechoslovak result's average standard of
# living, pop-weighted, over its pops in the sphere's part of the core parts' homeland states (a state
# that is the homeland of several counts once). Sets te_cm_sg_ref, 0 when the result has no pops there.
# The reference an optional part is held against once no core part has a figure left; run only then.
te_cmg_czechoslovak_result_sol = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = te_cm_starter
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rsolw value = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { te_cm_in_sphere = yes }
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:czech }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:slovak }
				}
			}
			every_scope_pop = {
				limit = { culture = cu:cm_czechoslovak }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops add = total_size }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rsolw add = { value = standard_of_living multiply = total_size } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops >= 1 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = te_cm_sg_ref
			value = {
				value = local_var:te_cm_sg_rsolw
				divide = local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_czechoslovak, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_czechoslovak_<culture>, over the core range plus that part; with no core figure left, against the
# result's (walked only then, and only while an optional part has not switched, joined or not: the gate of a part
# that has joined must keep following the result, or one dip would freeze it for good).
te_cmg_census_czechoslovak_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_czech } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = czechoslovak CULTURE = czech RESULT = cm_czechoslovak TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_slovak } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = czechoslovak CULTURE = slovak RESULT = cm_czechoslovak TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sorb } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = czechoslovak CULTURE = sorb RESULT = cm_czechoslovak TIER = 1 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_czechoslovak_czech_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = czechoslovak CULTURE = czech }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_czechoslovak_czech_measured = yes
				te_cmg_czechoslovak_czech_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_czechoslovak_slovak_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = czechoslovak CULTURE = slovak }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_czechoslovak_slovak_measured = yes
				te_cmg_czechoslovak_slovak_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 2 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_czechoslovak } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_czechoslovak value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_czechoslovak = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_czechoslovak value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_czechoslovak value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_ref value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:te_cm_sg_n = 0
			local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sorb }
			}
		}
		te_cmg_czechoslovak_result_sol = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sorb } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = czechoslovak CULTURE = sorb }
	}
	te_cmg_czechoslovak_settle = yes
}

# Country scope. Joins every part of the czechoslovak merge that can join now and isn't waiting on a
# vanilla entry: when the merge starts, and each census while its starter holds it. Nothing joins once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33).
te_cmg_czechoslovak_join_ready = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_czechoslovak } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_czechoslovak_czech_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = czechoslovak CULTURE = czech INDEX = 6 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_czechoslovak_slovak_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = czechoslovak CULTURE = slovak INDEX = 6 }
		}

			limit = {
				te_cmg_czechoslovak_sorb_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = czechoslovak CULTURE = sorb INDEX = 6 }

}

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_hungarian, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_hungarian_<culture>, over the core range plus that part; with no core figure left, against the
# result's (walked only then, and only while an optional part has not switched, joined or not: the gate of a part
# that has joined must keep following the result, or one dip would freeze it for good).
te_cmg_census_hungarian_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hungarian } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = hungarian CULTURE = hungarian RESULT = hungarian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_szekely } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = hungarian CULTURE = szekely RESULT = hungarian TIER = 1 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_hungarian_hungarian_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = hungarian CULTURE = hungarian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_hungarian_hungarian_measured = yes }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_hungarian_szekely_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = hungarian CULTURE = szekely }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_hungarian_szekely_measured = yes
				te_cmg_hungarian_szekely_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 2 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}

		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_hungarian } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_hungarian value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_hungarian = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_hungarian value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_hungarian value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	te_cmg_hungarian_settle = yes
}

# ---- dutch ----

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_dutch, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_dutch_<culture>, over the core range plus that part; with no core figure left, against the
# result's (walked only then, and only while an optional part has not switched, joined or not: the gate of a part
# that has joined must keep following the result, or one dip would freeze it for good).
te_cmg_census_dutch_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_dutch } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = dutch CULTURE = dutch RESULT = dutch TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_flemish } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = dutch CULTURE = flemish RESULT = dutch TIER = 1 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_dutch_dutch_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = dutch CULTURE = dutch }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_dutch_dutch_measured = yes }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_dutch_flemish_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = dutch CULTURE = flemish }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_dutch_flemish_measured = yes
				te_cmg_dutch_flemish_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 2 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_dutch } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_dutch value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_dutch = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_dutch value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_dutch value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	te_cmg_dutch_settle = yes
}

# Country scope. Joins every part of the dutch merge that can join now and isn't waiting on a
# vanilla entry: when the merge starts, and each census while its starter holds it. Nothing joins once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33).
te_cmg_dutch_join_ready = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_dutch } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_dutch_flemish_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = dutch CULTURE = flemish INDEX = 8 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: the button's effect. The country starts the dutch merge and brings in the parts it
# holds that qualify now. Only an idle merge starts: a second click on the same day finds it running.
te_cmg_start_dutch = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_dutch ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_dutch ?= 2 } }
		te_cm_start_merge = { MERGE = dutch RESULT = dutch }
		te_cmg_dutch_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Country scope: the tail of te_cmg_census_dutch_country, run after the part gates are fresh.
# 1. A wait year, while the merge could start but a vanilla entry on a core part is open in any country (once a census,
#    up to te_cm_wait_cap_years).
# 2. The journal entry's net: an idle merge's candidate that can start, or a running merge's starter,
#    gets the entry back if it holds neither the active nor the inactive record (a rule switched off and on
#    prunes the inactive ones; a concluded entry is gone). It reads the entry's own gate and never adds one for
#    a complete merge, whose finished entry is its end. Merge mechanics never key on the entry.
# 3. Late joins: the starter of a running or complete merge brings in every part that now qualifies.
te_cmg_dutch_settle = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			te_cm_system_enabled = yes
			NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_te_cm_dutch }
			NOT = { has_inactive_journal_entry = je_te_cm_dutch }
			OR = {
				te_cmg_dutch_can_start = yes
				AND = {
					global_var:te_cm_state_dutch ?= 1
					te_cmg_dutch_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
		}
		add_journal_entry = { type = je_te_cm_dutch }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_dutch_is_starter = yes }
		te_cmg_dutch_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_dutch = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_dutch ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_dutch ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_dutch_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_dutch_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_dutch }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_dutch = {
			te_cmg_census_dutch_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- finnish ----

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_finnish, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_finnish_<culture>, over the core range plus that part; with no core figure left, against the
# result's (walked only then, and only while an optional part has not switched, joined or not: the gate of a part
# that has joined must keep following the result, or one dip would freeze it for good).
te_cmg_census_finnish_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_finnish } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = finnish CULTURE = finnish RESULT = finnish TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_karelian } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = finnish CULTURE = karelian RESULT = finnish TIER = 1 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_finnish_finnish_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = finnish CULTURE = finnish }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_finnish_finnish_measured = yes }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_finnish_karelian_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = finnish CULTURE = karelian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_finnish_karelian_measured = yes
				te_cmg_finnish_karelian_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 2 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_finnish } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_finnish value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_finnish = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_finnish value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_finnish value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	te_cmg_finnish_settle = yes
}

# Country scope. Joins every part of the finnish merge that can join now and isn't waiting on a
# vanilla entry: when the merge starts, and each census while its starter holds it. Nothing joins once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33).
te_cmg_finnish_join_ready = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_finnish } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_finnish_karelian_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = finnish CULTURE = karelian INDEX = 9 }
		}
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_finnish ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_finnish ?= 2 } }

		te_cmg_finnish_join_ready = yes
	}

# Country scope: the tail of te_cmg_census_finnish_country, run after the part gates are fresh.

#    up to te_cm_wait_cap_years).
# 2. The journal entry's net: an idle merge's candidate that can start, or a running merge's starter,

			te_cmg_census_finnish_country = yes
		}

# ---- french ----

# Country scope: the candidate (or the running merge's starter). The french result's average standard of
# living, pop-weighted, over its pops in the sphere's part of the core parts' homeland states (a state
# that is the homeland of several counts once). Sets te_cm_sg_ref, 0 when the result has no pops there.
# The reference an optional part is held against once no core part has a figure left; run only then.
te_cmg_french_result_sol = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = te_cm_starter
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rsolw value = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { te_cm_in_sphere = yes }
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:french }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:wallonian }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:occitan }
				}
			}
			every_scope_pop = {
				limit = { culture = cu:french }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops add = total_size }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rsolw add = { value = standard_of_living multiply = total_size } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops >= 1 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = te_cm_sg_ref
			value = {
				value = local_var:te_cm_sg_rsolw
				divide = local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_french, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_french_<culture>, over the core range plus that part; with no core figure left, against the
# result's (walked only then, and only while an optional part has not switched, joined or not: the gate of a part
# that has joined must keep following the result, or one dip would freeze it for good).
te_cmg_census_french_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_french } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = french CULTURE = french RESULT = french TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_wallonian } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = french CULTURE = wallonian RESULT = french TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_occitan } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = french CULTURE = occitan RESULT = french TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_catalan } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = french CULTURE = catalan RESULT = french TIER = 3 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_french_french_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = french CULTURE = french }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_french_french_measured = yes }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_french_wallonian_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = french CULTURE = wallonian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_french_wallonian_measured = yes
				te_cmg_french_wallonian_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_french_occitan_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = french CULTURE = occitan }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_french_occitan_measured = yes
				te_cmg_french_occitan_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 3 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_french } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_french value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_french = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_french value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_french value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_ref value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:te_cm_sg_n = 0
			local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_catalan }
			}
		}
		te_cmg_french_result_sol = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_catalan } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = french CULTURE = catalan }
	}
	te_cmg_french_settle = yes
}

# Country scope. Joins every part of the french merge that can join now and isn't waiting on a
# vanilla entry: when the merge starts, and each census while its starter holds it. Nothing joins once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33).
te_cmg_french_join_ready = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_french } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_french_wallonian_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = french CULTURE = wallonian INDEX = 10 }
		}

			limit = {
				te_cmg_french_occitan_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = french CULTURE = occitan INDEX = 10 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_french_catalan_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = french CULTURE = catalan INDEX = 10 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: the button's effect. The country starts the french merge and brings in the parts it
# holds that qualify now. Only an idle merge starts: a second click on the same day finds it running.
# Not once its result has switched into a wider culture (R36): that culture has gone, and a start would make it a
# primary culture again. The button's can_start says so too; this is the guard behind it.
te_cmg_start_french = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_french ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_french ?= 2 }
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_french }
		}
		te_cm_start_merge = { MERGE = french RESULT = french }
		te_cmg_french_join_ready = yes
	}
}

			te_cm_system_enabled = yes
			NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_te_cm_french }
			NOT = { has_inactive_journal_entry = je_te_cm_french }
			OR = {
				te_cmg_french_can_start = yes
				AND = {
					global_var:te_cm_state_french ?= 1
					te_cmg_french_is_starter = yes

			OR = {
				te_cmg_british_scottish_measured = yes
				te_cmg_british_scottish_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 2 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_british } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_british value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_british = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_british value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_british value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	te_cmg_british_settle = yes
}

# Country scope. Joins every part of the british merge that can join now and isn't waiting on a
# vanilla entry: when the merge starts, and each census while its starter holds it. Nothing joins once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33).
te_cmg_british_join_ready = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_british } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_british_scottish_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = british CULTURE = scottish INDEX = 11 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: the button's effect. The country starts the british merge and brings in the parts it
# holds that qualify now. Only an idle merge starts: a second click on the same day finds it running.
# Not once its result has switched into a wider culture (R36): that culture has gone, and a start would make it a
# primary culture again. The button's can_start says so too; this is the guard behind it.
te_cmg_start_british = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_british ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_british ?= 2 }
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_british }
		}
		te_cm_start_merge = { MERGE = british RESULT = british }
		te_cmg_british_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Country scope: the tail of te_cmg_census_british_country, run after the part gates are fresh.
# 1. A wait year, while the merge could start but a vanilla entry on a core part is open in any country (once a census,
#    up to te_cm_wait_cap_years).
# 2. The journal entry's net: an idle merge's candidate that can start, or a running merge's starter,
#    gets the entry back if it holds neither the active nor the inactive record (a rule switched off and on
#    prunes the inactive ones; a concluded entry is gone). It reads the entry's own gate and never adds one for
#    a complete merge, whose finished entry is its end. Merge mechanics never key on the entry.
# 3. Late joins: the starter of a running or complete merge brings in every part that now qualifies.
te_cmg_british_settle = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			te_cm_system_enabled = yes
			NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_te_cm_british }
			NOT = { has_inactive_journal_entry = je_te_cm_british }
			OR = {
				te_cmg_british_can_start = yes
				AND = {
					global_var:te_cm_state_british ?= 1
					te_cmg_british_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
		}
		add_journal_entry = { type = je_te_cm_british }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_british_is_starter = yes }
		te_cmg_british_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_british = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_british ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_british ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_british_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_british_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_british }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_british = {
			te_cmg_census_british_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- american ----

# Country scope: the candidate (or the running merge's starter). The american result's average standard of
# living, pop-weighted, over its pops in the sphere's part of the core parts' homeland states (a state
# that is the homeland of several counts once). Sets te_cm_sg_ref, 0 when the result has no pops there.
# The reference an optional part is held against once no core part has a figure left; run only then.
te_cmg_american_result_sol = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = te_cm_starter
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rsolw value = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { te_cm_in_sphere = yes }
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:yankee }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:dixie }
				}
			}
			every_scope_pop = {
				limit = { culture = cu:cm_american }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops add = total_size }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rsolw add = { value = standard_of_living multiply = total_size } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops >= 1 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = te_cm_sg_ref
			value = {
				value = local_var:te_cm_sg_rsolw
				divide = local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_american, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_american_<culture>, over the core range plus that part; with no core figure left, against the
# result's (walked only then, and only while an optional part has not switched, joined or not: the gate of a part
# that has joined must keep following the result, or one dip would freeze it for good).
te_cmg_census_american_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yankee } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = american CULTURE = yankee RESULT = cm_american TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_dixie } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = american CULTURE = dixie RESULT = cm_american TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_american } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = american CULTURE = afro_american RESULT = cm_american TIER = 2 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_american_yankee_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = american CULTURE = yankee }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_american_yankee_measured = yes
				te_cmg_american_yankee_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_american_dixie_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = american CULTURE = dixie }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_american_dixie_measured = yes
				te_cmg_american_dixie_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 2 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_american } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_american value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_american = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_american value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_american value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_ref value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:te_cm_sg_n = 0
			local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_american }
			}
		}
		te_cmg_american_result_sol = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_american } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = american CULTURE = afro_american }
	}
	te_cmg_american_settle = yes
}

# Country scope. Joins every part of the american merge that can join now and isn't waiting on a
# vanilla entry: when the merge starts, and each census while its starter holds it. Nothing joins once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33).
te_cmg_american_join_ready = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_american } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_american_yankee_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = american CULTURE = yankee INDEX = 12 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_american_dixie_can_join = yes
				NOT = { te_cmg_american_dixie_waiting = yes }
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = american CULTURE = dixie INDEX = 12 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_american_afro_american_can_join = yes
				NOT = { te_cmg_american_afro_american_waiting = yes }
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = american CULTURE = afro_american INDEX = 12 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: the button's effect. The country starts the american merge and brings in the parts it
# holds that qualify now. Only an idle merge starts: a second click on the same day finds it running.
# Not once its result has switched into a wider culture (R36): that culture has gone, and a start would make it a
# primary culture again. The button's can_start says so too; this is the guard behind it.
te_cmg_start_american = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_american ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_american ?= 2 }
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_american }
		}
		te_cm_start_merge = { MERGE = american RESULT = cm_american }
		te_cmg_american_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Country scope: the tail of te_cmg_census_american_country, run after the part gates are fresh.
# 1. A wait year, while the merge could start but a vanilla entry on a core part is open in any country (once a census,
#    up to te_cm_wait_cap_years).
# 2. The journal entry's net: an idle merge's candidate that can start, or a running merge's starter,
#    gets the entry back if it holds neither the active nor the inactive record (a rule switched off and on
#    prunes the inactive ones; a concluded entry is gone). It reads the entry's own gate and never adds one for
#    a complete merge, whose finished entry is its end. Merge mechanics never key on the entry.
# 3. Late joins: the starter of a running or complete merge brings in every part that now qualifies.
te_cmg_american_settle = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			te_cmg_american_start_basics = yes
			OR = {
				any_country = {
					has_journal_entry = je_acw_reincorporate
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_wait_years_american } }
			set_variable = { name = te_cm_wait_years_american value = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_wait_years_american < te_cm_wait_cap_years }
			change_variable = { name = te_cm_wait_years_american add = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			te_cm_system_enabled = yes
			NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_te_cm_american }
			NOT = { has_inactive_journal_entry = je_te_cm_american }
			OR = {
				te_cmg_american_can_start = yes
				AND = {
					global_var:te_cm_state_american ?= 1
					te_cmg_american_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
		}
		add_journal_entry = { type = je_te_cm_american }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_american_is_starter = yes }
		te_cmg_american_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_american = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_american ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_american ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_american_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_american_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_american }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_american = {
			te_cmg_census_american_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- anglophone ----

# Country scope: the candidate (or the running merge's starter). The anglophone result's average standard of
# living, pop-weighted, over its pops in the sphere's part of the core parts' homeland states (a state
# that is the homeland of several counts once). Sets te_cm_sg_ref, 0 when the result has no pops there.
# The reference an optional part is held against once no core part has a figure left; run only then.

	save_temporary_scope_as = te_cm_starter
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rsolw value = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { te_cm_in_sphere = yes }
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:british }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:yankee }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:cm_american }
				}
			}
			every_scope_pop = {
				limit = { culture = cu:cm_anglophone }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops add = total_size }

			}
		}
	}
