		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops >= 1 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = te_cm_sg_ref
			value = {
				value = local_var:te_cm_sg_rsolw
				divide = local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_anglophone, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_anglophone_<culture>, over the core range plus that part; with no core figure left, against the
# result's (walked only then, and only while an optional part has not switched, joined or not: the gate of a part
# that has joined must keep following the result, or one dip would freeze it for good).
te_cmg_census_anglophone_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_british } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = british RESULT = cm_anglophone TIER = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yankee } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = yankee RESULT = cm_anglophone TIER = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_american } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = cm_american RESULT = cm_anglophone TIER = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_anglo_canadian } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = anglo_canadian RESULT = cm_anglophone TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_australian } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = australian RESULT = cm_anglophone TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_scottish } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = scottish RESULT = cm_anglophone TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_dixie } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = dixie RESULT = cm_anglophone TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_american } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = afro_american RESULT = cm_anglophone TIER = 2 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_anglophone_british_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = british }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_anglophone_british_measured = yes
				te_cmg_anglophone_british_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = yankee }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = cm_american }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_measured = yes
				te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_measured = yes
				te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_switched_in = yes
				te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 2 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_anglophone } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_anglophone value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_anglophone = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_anglophone value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_anglophone value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_ref value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:te_cm_sg_n = 0
			local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_anglo_canadian }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_australian }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_scottish }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_dixie }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_american }
			}
		}
		te_cmg_anglophone_result_sol = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_anglo_canadian } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = anglo_canadian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_australian } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = australian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_scottish } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = scottish }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_dixie } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = dixie }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_american } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = afro_american }
	}
	te_cmg_anglophone_settle = yes
}

# Country scope. Joins every part of the anglophone merge that can join now and isn't waiting on a
# vanilla entry: when the merge starts, and each census while its starter holds it. Nothing joins once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33).
te_cmg_anglophone_join_ready = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_anglophone } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_anglophone_british_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = british INDEX = 13 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_anglophone_yankee_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = yankee INDEX = 13 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_anglophone_cm_american_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = cm_american INDEX = 13 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_anglophone_anglo_canadian_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = anglo_canadian INDEX = 13 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_anglophone_australian_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = australian INDEX = 13 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_anglophone_scottish_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = scottish INDEX = 13 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_anglophone_dixie_can_join = yes
				NOT = { te_cmg_anglophone_dixie_waiting = yes }
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = dixie INDEX = 13 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_anglophone_afro_american_can_join = yes
				NOT = { te_cmg_anglophone_afro_american_waiting = yes }
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = anglophone CULTURE = afro_american INDEX = 13 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: the button's effect. The country starts the anglophone merge and brings in the parts it
# holds that qualify now. Only an idle merge starts: a second click on the same day finds it running.
te_cmg_start_anglophone = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_anglophone ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_anglophone ?= 2 } }
		te_cm_start_merge = { MERGE = anglophone RESULT = cm_anglophone }
		te_cmg_anglophone_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Country scope: the tail of te_cmg_census_anglophone_country, run after the part gates are fresh.
# 1. A wait year, while the merge could start but a vanilla entry on a core part is open in any country (once a census,
#    up to te_cm_wait_cap_years).
# 2. The journal entry's net: an idle merge's candidate that can start, or a running merge's starter,
#    gets the entry back if it holds neither the active nor the inactive record (a rule switched off and on
#    prunes the inactive ones; a concluded entry is gone). It reads the entry's own gate and never adds one for
#    a complete merge, whose finished entry is its end. Merge mechanics never key on the entry.
# 3. Late joins: the starter of a running or complete merge brings in every part that now qualifies.
te_cmg_anglophone_settle = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			te_cm_system_enabled = yes
			NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_te_cm_anglophone }
			NOT = { has_inactive_journal_entry = je_te_cm_anglophone }
			OR = {
				te_cmg_anglophone_can_start = yes
				AND = {
					global_var:te_cm_state_anglophone ?= 1
					te_cmg_anglophone_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
		}
		add_journal_entry = { type = je_te_cm_anglophone }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_anglophone_is_starter = yes }
		te_cmg_anglophone_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_anglophone = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_anglophone ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_anglophone ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_anglophone_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_anglophone_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_anglophone }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_anglophone = {
			te_cmg_census_anglophone_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- brazilian ----

# Country scope: the candidate (or the running merge's starter). The brazilian result's average standard of
# living, pop-weighted, over its pops in the sphere's part of the core parts' homeland states (a state
# that is the homeland of several counts once). Sets te_cm_sg_ref, 0 when the result has no pops there.
# The reference an optional part is held against once no core part has a figure left; run only then.
te_cmg_brazilian_result_sol = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = te_cm_starter
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rsolw value = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { te_cm_in_sphere = yes }
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:brazilian }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:nordestino }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:paulista }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:amazonic }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:sulista }
				}
			}
			every_scope_pop = {
				limit = { culture = cu:brazilian }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops add = total_size }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rsolw add = { value = standard_of_living multiply = total_size } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops >= 1 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = te_cm_sg_ref
			value = {
				value = local_var:te_cm_sg_rsolw
				divide = local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_brazilian, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_brazilian_<culture>, over the core range plus that part; with no core figure left, against the
# result's (walked only then, and only while an optional part has not switched, joined or not: the gate of a part
# that has joined must keep following the result, or one dip would freeze it for good).
te_cmg_census_brazilian_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_brazilian } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = brazilian CULTURE = brazilian RESULT = brazilian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_nordestino } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = brazilian CULTURE = nordestino RESULT = brazilian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_paulista } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = brazilian CULTURE = paulista RESULT = brazilian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_amazonic } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = brazilian CULTURE = amazonic RESULT = brazilian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sulista } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = brazilian CULTURE = sulista RESULT = brazilian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_brazilian } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = brazilian CULTURE = afro_brazilian RESULT = brazilian TIER = 2 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_brazilian_brazilian_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = brazilian CULTURE = brazilian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_brazilian_brazilian_measured = yes }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_brazilian_nordestino_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = brazilian CULTURE = nordestino }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_brazilian_nordestino_measured = yes
				te_cmg_brazilian_nordestino_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_brazilian_paulista_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = brazilian CULTURE = paulista }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_brazilian_paulista_measured = yes
				te_cmg_brazilian_paulista_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_brazilian_amazonic_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = brazilian CULTURE = amazonic }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_brazilian_amazonic_measured = yes
				te_cmg_brazilian_amazonic_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_brazilian_sulista_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = brazilian CULTURE = sulista }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_brazilian_sulista_measured = yes
				te_cmg_brazilian_sulista_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 5 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_brazilian } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_brazilian value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_brazilian = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_brazilian value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_brazilian value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_ref value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:te_cm_sg_n = 0
			local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_brazilian }
			}
		}
		te_cmg_brazilian_result_sol = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_afro_brazilian } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = brazilian CULTURE = afro_brazilian }
	}
	te_cmg_brazilian_settle = yes
}

# ---- platine ----

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_platine, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_platine_<culture>, over the core range plus that part; with no core figure left, against the
# result's (walked only then, and only while an optional part has not switched, joined or not: the gate of a part
# that has joined must keep following the result, or one dip would freeze it for good).
te_cmg_census_platine_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_platinean } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = platine CULTURE = platinean RESULT = cm_platine TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_argentine } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = platine CULTURE = argentine RESULT = cm_platine TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uruguayan } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = platine CULTURE = uruguayan RESULT = cm_platine TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_paraguayan } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = platine CULTURE = paraguayan RESULT = cm_platine TIER = 1 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_platine_platinean_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = platine CULTURE = platinean }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_platine_platinean_measured = yes
				te_cmg_platine_platinean_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_platine_argentine_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = platine CULTURE = argentine }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_platine_argentine_measured = yes
				te_cmg_platine_argentine_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_platine_uruguayan_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = platine CULTURE = uruguayan }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_platine_uruguayan_measured = yes
				te_cmg_platine_uruguayan_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_platine_paraguayan_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = platine CULTURE = paraguayan }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_platine_paraguayan_measured = yes
				te_cmg_platine_paraguayan_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 4 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_platine } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_platine value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_platine = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_platine value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_platine value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	te_cmg_platine_settle = yes
}

# Country scope. Joins every part of the platine merge that can join now and isn't waiting on a
# vanilla entry: when the merge starts, and each census while its starter holds it. Nothing joins once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33).
te_cmg_platine_join_ready = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_platine } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_platine_platinean_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = platine CULTURE = platinean INDEX = 15 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_platine_argentine_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = platine CULTURE = argentine INDEX = 15 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_platine_uruguayan_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = platine CULTURE = uruguayan INDEX = 15 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_platine_paraguayan_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = platine CULTURE = paraguayan INDEX = 15 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: the button's effect. The country starts the platine merge and brings in the parts it
# holds that qualify now. Only an idle merge starts: a second click on the same day finds it running.
te_cmg_start_platine = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_platine ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_platine ?= 2 } }
		te_cm_start_merge = { MERGE = platine RESULT = cm_platine }
		te_cmg_platine_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Country scope: the tail of te_cmg_census_platine_country, run after the part gates are fresh.
# 1. A wait year, while the merge could start but a vanilla entry on a core part is open in any country (once a census,
#    up to te_cm_wait_cap_years).
# 2. The journal entry's net: an idle merge's candidate that can start, or a running merge's starter,
#    gets the entry back if it holds neither the active nor the inactive record (a rule switched off and on
#    prunes the inactive ones; a concluded entry is gone). It reads the entry's own gate and never adds one for
#    a complete merge, whose finished entry is its end. Merge mechanics never key on the entry.
# 3. Late joins: the starter of a running or complete merge brings in every part that now qualifies.
te_cmg_platine_settle = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			te_cm_system_enabled = yes
			NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_te_cm_platine }
			NOT = { has_inactive_journal_entry = je_te_cm_platine }
			OR = {
				te_cmg_platine_can_start = yes
				AND = {
					global_var:te_cm_state_platine ?= 1
					te_cmg_platine_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
		}
		add_journal_entry = { type = je_te_cm_platine }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_platine_is_starter = yes }
		te_cmg_platine_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_platine = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_platine ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_platine ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_platine_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_platine_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_platine }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_platine = {
			te_cmg_census_platine_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- andean ----

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_andean, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_andean_<culture>, over the core range plus that part; with no core figure left, against the
# result's (walked only then, and only while an optional part has not switched, joined or not: the gate of a part
# that has joined must keep following the result, or one dip would freeze it for good).
te_cmg_census_andean_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_andean } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = andean CULTURE = north_andean RESULT = cm_andean TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_south_andean } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = andean CULTURE = south_andean RESULT = cm_andean TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_peruvian } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = andean CULTURE = peruvian RESULT = cm_andean TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bolivian } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = andean CULTURE = bolivian RESULT = cm_andean TIER = 1 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_andean_north_andean_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = andean CULTURE = north_andean }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_andean_north_andean_measured = yes
				te_cmg_andean_north_andean_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_andean_south_andean_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = andean CULTURE = south_andean }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_andean_south_andean_measured = yes
				te_cmg_andean_south_andean_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_andean_peruvian_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = andean CULTURE = peruvian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_andean_peruvian_measured = yes
				te_cmg_andean_peruvian_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_andean_bolivian_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = andean CULTURE = bolivian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_andean_bolivian_measured = yes
				te_cmg_andean_bolivian_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 4 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_andean } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_andean value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_andean = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_andean value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_andean value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	te_cmg_andean_settle = yes
}

# Country scope. Joins every part of the andean merge that can join now and isn't waiting on a
# vanilla entry: when the merge starts, and each census while its starter holds it. Nothing joins once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33).
te_cmg_andean_join_ready = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_andean } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_andean_north_andean_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = andean CULTURE = north_andean INDEX = 16 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_andean_south_andean_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = andean CULTURE = south_andean INDEX = 16 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_andean_peruvian_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = andean CULTURE = peruvian INDEX = 16 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_andean_bolivian_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = andean CULTURE = bolivian INDEX = 16 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: the button's effect. The country starts the andean merge and brings in the parts it
# holds that qualify now. Only an idle merge starts: a second click on the same day finds it running.
te_cmg_start_andean = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_andean ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_andean ?= 2 } }
		te_cm_start_merge = { MERGE = andean RESULT = cm_andean }
		te_cmg_andean_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# ---- gran_colombian ----

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_gran_colombian, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_gran_colombian_<culture>, over the core range plus that part; with no core figure left, against the
# result's (walked only then, and only while an optional part has not switched, joined or not: the gate of a part
# that has joined must keep following the result, or one dip would freeze it for good).
te_cmg_census_gran_colombian_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_colombian } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = gran_colombian CULTURE = colombian RESULT = cm_gran_colombian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_venezuelan } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = gran_colombian CULTURE = venezuelan RESULT = cm_gran_colombian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ecuadorian } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = gran_colombian CULTURE = ecuadorian RESULT = cm_gran_colombian TIER = 1 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_gran_colombian_colombian_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = gran_colombian CULTURE = colombian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_gran_colombian_colombian_measured = yes
				te_cmg_gran_colombian_colombian_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_gran_colombian_venezuelan_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = gran_colombian CULTURE = venezuelan }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_gran_colombian_venezuelan_measured = yes
				te_cmg_gran_colombian_venezuelan_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_gran_colombian_ecuadorian_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = gran_colombian CULTURE = ecuadorian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_gran_colombian_ecuadorian_measured = yes
				te_cmg_gran_colombian_ecuadorian_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 3 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_gran_colombian } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_gran_colombian value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_gran_colombian = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_gran_colombian value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_gran_colombian value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	te_cmg_gran_colombian_settle = yes
}

# ---- chinese ----

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_chinese, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_chinese_<culture>, over the core range plus that part; with no core figure left, against the
# result's (walked only then, and only while an optional part has not switched, joined or not: the gate of a part
# that has joined must keep following the result, or one dip would freeze it for good).
te_cmg_census_chinese_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_han } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = chinese CULTURE = han RESULT = han TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yue } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = chinese CULTURE = yue RESULT = han TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_min } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = chinese CULTURE = min RESULT = han TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hakka } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = chinese CULTURE = hakka RESULT = han TIER = 1 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_chinese_han_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = chinese CULTURE = han }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_chinese_han_measured = yes }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_chinese_yue_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = chinese CULTURE = yue }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_chinese_yue_measured = yes
				te_cmg_chinese_yue_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_chinese_min_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = chinese CULTURE = min }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_chinese_min_measured = yes
				te_cmg_chinese_min_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_chinese_hakka_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = chinese CULTURE = hakka }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_chinese_hakka_measured = yes
				te_cmg_chinese_hakka_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 4 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_chinese } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_chinese value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_chinese = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_chinese value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_chinese value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	te_cmg_chinese_settle = yes
}

# Country scope. Joins every part of the chinese merge that can join now and isn't waiting on a
# vanilla entry: when the merge starts, and each census while its starter holds it. Nothing joins once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33).
te_cmg_chinese_join_ready = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_han } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_chinese_yue_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = chinese CULTURE = yue INDEX = 18 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_chinese_min_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = chinese CULTURE = min INDEX = 18 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_chinese_hakka_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = chinese CULTURE = hakka INDEX = 18 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: the button's effect. The country starts the chinese merge and brings in the parts it
# holds that qualify now. Only an idle merge starts: a second click on the same day finds it running.
te_cmg_start_chinese = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_chinese ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_chinese ?= 2 } }
		te_cm_start_merge = { MERGE = chinese RESULT = han }
		te_cmg_chinese_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Country scope: the tail of te_cmg_census_chinese_country, run after the part gates are fresh.
# 1. A wait year, while the merge could start but a vanilla entry on a core part is open in any country (once a census,
#    up to te_cm_wait_cap_years).
# 2. The journal entry's net: an idle merge's candidate that can start, or a running merge's starter,
#    gets the entry back if it holds neither the active nor the inactive record (a rule switched off and on
#    prunes the inactive ones; a concluded entry is gone). It reads the entry's own gate and never adds one for
#    a complete merge, whose finished entry is its end. Merge mechanics never key on the entry.
# 3. Late joins: the starter of a running or complete merge brings in every part that now qualifies.
te_cmg_chinese_settle = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			te_cm_system_enabled = yes
			NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_te_cm_chinese }
			NOT = { has_inactive_journal_entry = je_te_cm_chinese }
			OR = {
				te_cmg_chinese_can_start = yes
				AND = {
					global_var:te_cm_state_chinese ?= 1
					te_cmg_chinese_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
		}
		add_journal_entry = { type = je_te_cm_chinese }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_chinese_is_starter = yes }
		te_cmg_chinese_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_chinese = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_chinese ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_chinese ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_chinese_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_chinese_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_chinese }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_chinese = {
			te_cmg_census_chinese_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- japanese ----

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_japanese, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_japanese_<culture>, over the core range plus that part; with no core figure left, against the
# result's (walked only then, and only while an optional part has not switched, joined or not: the gate of a part
# that has joined must keep following the result, or one dip would freeze it for good).
te_cmg_census_japanese_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_japanese } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = japanese CULTURE = japanese RESULT = japanese TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ryukyuan } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = japanese CULTURE = ryukyuan RESULT = japanese TIER = 1 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_japanese_japanese_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = japanese CULTURE = japanese }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_japanese_japanese_measured = yes }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_japanese_ryukyuan_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = japanese CULTURE = ryukyuan }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_japanese_ryukyuan_measured = yes
				te_cmg_japanese_ryukyuan_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 2 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_japanese } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_japanese value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_japanese = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_japanese value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_japanese value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	te_cmg_japanese_settle = yes
}

# Country scope. Joins every part of the japanese merge that can join now and isn't waiting on a
# vanilla entry: when the merge starts, and each census while its starter holds it. Nothing joins once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33).
te_cmg_japanese_join_ready = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_japanese } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_japanese_ryukyuan_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = japanese CULTURE = ryukyuan INDEX = 19 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: the button's effect. The country starts the japanese merge and brings in the parts it

te_cmg_start_japanese = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_japanese ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_japanese ?= 2 } }
		te_cm_start_merge = { MERGE = japanese RESULT = japanese }
		te_cmg_japanese_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# 1. A wait year, while the merge could start but a vanilla entry on a core part is open in any country (once a census,

# 2. The journal entry's net: an idle merge's candidate that can start, or a running merge's starter,

				te_cmg_japanese_can_start = yes

# ---- arab ----

# Country scope: the candidate (or the running merge's starter). The arab result's average standard of
# living, pop-weighted, over its pops in the sphere's part of the core parts' homeland states (a state
# that is the homeland of several counts once). Sets te_cm_sg_ref, 0 when the result has no pops there.
# The reference an optional part is held against once no core part has a figure left; run only then.
te_cmg_arab_result_sol = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = te_cm_starter
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rsolw value = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { te_cm_in_sphere = yes }
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:maghrebi }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:misri }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:mashriqi }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:bedouin }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:yemenite }
				}
			}
			every_scope_pop = {
				limit = { culture = cu:cm_arab }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops add = total_size }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rsolw add = { value = standard_of_living multiply = total_size } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops >= 1 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = te_cm_sg_ref
			value = {
				value = local_var:te_cm_sg_rsolw
				divide = local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_arab, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_arab_<culture>, over the core range plus that part; with no core figure left, against the
# result's (walked only then, and only while an optional part has not switched, joined or not: the gate of a part
# that has joined must keep following the result, or one dip would freeze it for good).
te_cmg_census_arab_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_maghrebi } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = maghrebi RESULT = cm_arab TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_misri } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = misri RESULT = cm_arab TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_mashriqi } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = mashriqi RESULT = cm_arab TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bedouin } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = bedouin RESULT = cm_arab TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yemenite } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = yemenite RESULT = cm_arab TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sudanese } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = sudanese RESULT = cm_arab TIER = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_haratin } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = haratin RESULT = cm_arab TIER = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bidan } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = bidan RESULT = cm_arab TIER = 2 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_arab_maghrebi_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = maghrebi }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_arab_maghrebi_measured = yes
				te_cmg_arab_maghrebi_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_arab_misri_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = misri }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_arab_misri_measured = yes
				te_cmg_arab_misri_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_arab_mashriqi_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = mashriqi }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_arab_mashriqi_measured = yes
				te_cmg_arab_mashriqi_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_arab_bedouin_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = bedouin }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_arab_bedouin_measured = yes
				te_cmg_arab_bedouin_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_arab_yemenite_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = yemenite }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_arab_yemenite_measured = yes
				te_cmg_arab_yemenite_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 5 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_arab } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_arab value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_arab = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_arab value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_arab value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_ref value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:te_cm_sg_n = 0
			local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sudanese }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_haratin }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bidan }
			}
		}
		te_cmg_arab_result_sol = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sudanese } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = sudanese }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_haratin } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = haratin }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bidan } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = arab CULTURE = bidan }
	}
	te_cmg_arab_settle = yes
}

}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_arab = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_arab ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_arab ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_arab_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_arab_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_arab }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_arab = {
			te_cmg_census_arab_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- persian ----

# Country scope: the candidate (or the running merge's starter). The persian result's average standard of
# living, pop-weighted, over its pops in the sphere's part of the core parts' homeland states (a state
# that is the homeland of several counts once). Sets te_cm_sg_ref, 0 when the result has no pops there.
# The reference an optional part is held against once no core part has a figure left; run only then.
te_cmg_persian_result_sol = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = te_cm_starter
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rsolw value = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { te_cm_in_sphere = yes }
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:persian }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:luri }
				}
			}
			every_scope_pop = {
				limit = { culture = cu:persian }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops add = total_size }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rsolw add = { value = standard_of_living multiply = total_size } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops >= 1 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = te_cm_sg_ref
			value = {
				value = local_var:te_cm_sg_rsolw
				divide = local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_persian, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_persian_<culture>, over the core range plus that part; with no core figure left, against the
# result's (walked only then, and only while an optional part has not switched, joined or not: the gate of a part
# that has joined must keep following the result, or one dip would freeze it for good).
te_cmg_census_persian_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_persian } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = persian CULTURE = persian RESULT = persian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_luri } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = persian CULTURE = luri RESULT = persian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tajik } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = persian CULTURE = tajik RESULT = persian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hazara } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = persian CULTURE = hazara RESULT = persian TIER = 2 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_persian_persian_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = persian CULTURE = persian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_persian_persian_measured = yes }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_persian_luri_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = persian CULTURE = luri }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_persian_luri_measured = yes
				te_cmg_persian_luri_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 2 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_persian } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_persian value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_persian = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_persian value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_persian value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_ref value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:te_cm_sg_n = 0
			local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tajik }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hazara }
			}
		}
		te_cmg_persian_result_sol = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tajik } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = persian CULTURE = tajik }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hazara } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = persian CULTURE = hazara }
	}
	te_cmg_persian_settle = yes
}

# Country scope. Joins every part of the persian merge that can join now and isn't waiting on a
# vanilla entry: when the merge starts, and each census while its starter holds it. Nothing joins once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33).
te_cmg_persian_join_ready = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_persian } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_persian_luri_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = persian CULTURE = luri INDEX = 21 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_persian_tajik_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = persian CULTURE = tajik INDEX = 21 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_persian_hazara_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = persian CULTURE = hazara INDEX = 21 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: the button's effect. The country starts the persian merge and brings in the parts it
# holds that qualify now. Only an idle merge starts: a second click on the same day finds it running.
te_cmg_start_persian = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_persian ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_persian ?= 2 } }
		te_cm_start_merge = { MERGE = persian RESULT = persian }
		te_cmg_persian_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Country scope: the tail of te_cmg_census_persian_country, run after the part gates are fresh.
# 1. A wait year, while the merge could start but a vanilla entry on a core part is open in any country (once a census,
#    up to te_cm_wait_cap_years).
# 2. The journal entry's net: an idle merge's candidate that can start, or a running merge's starter,
#    gets the entry back if it holds neither the active nor the inactive record (a rule switched off and on
#    prunes the inactive ones; a concluded entry is gone). It reads the entry's own gate and never adds one for
#    a complete merge, whose finished entry is its end. Merge mechanics never key on the entry.
# 3. Late joins: the starter of a running or complete merge brings in every part that now qualifies.
te_cmg_persian_settle = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			te_cm_system_enabled = yes
			NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_te_cm_persian }
			NOT = { has_inactive_journal_entry = je_te_cm_persian }
			OR = {
				te_cmg_persian_can_start = yes
				AND = {
					global_var:te_cm_state_persian ?= 1
					te_cmg_persian_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
		}
		add_journal_entry = { type = je_te_cm_persian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_persian_is_starter = yes }
		te_cmg_persian_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_persian = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_persian ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_persian ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_persian_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_persian_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_persian }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_persian = {
			te_cmg_census_persian_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- oghuz_turkic ----

# Country scope: the candidate (or the running merge's starter). The oghuz_turkic result's average standard of
# living, pop-weighted, over its pops in the sphere's part of the core parts' homeland states (a state
# that is the homeland of several counts once). Sets te_cm_sg_ref, 0 when the result has no pops there.
# The reference an optional part is held against once no core part has a figure left; run only then.
te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_result_sol = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = te_cm_starter
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rsolw value = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { te_cm_in_sphere = yes }
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:turkish }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:azerbaijani }
				}
			}
			every_scope_pop = {
				limit = { culture = cu:cm_oghuz_turkic }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops add = total_size }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rsolw add = { value = standard_of_living multiply = total_size } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops >= 1 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = te_cm_sg_ref
			value = {
				value = local_var:te_cm_sg_rsolw
				divide = local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_oghuz_turkic, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_oghuz_turkic_<culture>, over the core range plus that part; with no core figure left, against the
# result's (walked only then, and only while an optional part has not switched, joined or not: the gate of a part
# that has joined must keep following the result, or one dip would freeze it for good).
te_cmg_census_oghuz_turkic_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_turkish } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = oghuz_turkic CULTURE = turkish RESULT = cm_oghuz_turkic TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_azerbaijani } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = oghuz_turkic CULTURE = azerbaijani RESULT = cm_oghuz_turkic TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_turkmen } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = oghuz_turkic CULTURE = turkmen RESULT = cm_oghuz_turkic TIER = 2 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_turkish_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = oghuz_turkic CULTURE = turkish }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_turkish_measured = yes
				te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_turkish_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = oghuz_turkic CULTURE = azerbaijani }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani_measured = yes
				te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 2 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_oghuz_turkic } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_oghuz_turkic value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_oghuz_turkic = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_oghuz_turkic value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_oghuz_turkic value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_ref value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:te_cm_sg_n = 0
			local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_turkmen }
			}
		}
		te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_result_sol = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_turkmen } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = oghuz_turkic CULTURE = turkmen }
	}
	te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_settle = yes
}

# Country scope. Joins every part of the oghuz_turkic merge that can join now and isn't waiting on a
# vanilla entry: when the merge starts, and each census while its starter holds it. Nothing joins once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33).
te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_join_ready = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_oghuz_turkic } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_turkish_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = oghuz_turkic CULTURE = turkish INDEX = 22 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_azerbaijani_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = oghuz_turkic CULTURE = azerbaijani INDEX = 22 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_turkmen_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = oghuz_turkic CULTURE = turkmen INDEX = 22 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: the button's effect. The country starts the oghuz_turkic merge and brings in the parts it
# holds that qualify now. Only an idle merge starts: a second click on the same day finds it running.
# Not once its result has switched into a wider culture (R36): that culture has gone, and a start would make it a
# primary culture again. The button's can_start says so too; this is the guard behind it.
te_cmg_start_oghuz_turkic = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_oghuz_turkic ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_oghuz_turkic ?= 2 }
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_oghuz_turkic }
		}
		te_cm_start_merge = { MERGE = oghuz_turkic RESULT = cm_oghuz_turkic }
		te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Country scope: the tail of te_cmg_census_oghuz_turkic_country, run after the part gates are fresh.
# 1. A wait year, while the merge could start but a vanilla entry on a core part is open in any country (once a census,
#    up to te_cm_wait_cap_years).
# 2. The journal entry's net: an idle merge's candidate that can start, or a running merge's starter,
#    gets the entry back if it holds neither the active nor the inactive record (a rule switched off and on
#    prunes the inactive ones; a concluded entry is gone). It reads the entry's own gate and never adds one for
#    a complete merge, whose finished entry is its end. Merge mechanics never key on the entry.
# 3. Late joins: the starter of a running or complete merge brings in every part that now qualifies.
te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_settle = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			te_cm_system_enabled = yes
			NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_te_cm_oghuz_turkic }
			NOT = { has_inactive_journal_entry = je_te_cm_oghuz_turkic }
			OR = {
				te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_can_start = yes
				AND = {
					global_var:te_cm_state_oghuz_turkic ?= 1
					te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
		}
		add_journal_entry = { type = je_te_cm_oghuz_turkic }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_is_starter = yes }
		te_cmg_oghuz_turkic_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
