# ---- hindustani ----

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_hindustani, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_hindustani_<culture>, over the core range plus that part; with no core figure left, against the
# result's (walked only then, and only while an optional part has not switched, joined or not: the gate of a part
# that has joined must keep following the result, or one dip would freeze it for good).
te_cmg_census_hindustani_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hindustani } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = hindustani CULTURE = hindustani RESULT = hindustani TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_avadhi } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = hindustani CULTURE = avadhi RESULT = hindustani TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bundeli } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = hindustani CULTURE = bundeli RESULT = hindustani TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_chhattisgarhi } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = hindustani CULTURE = chhattisgarhi RESULT = hindustani TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bageli } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = hindustani CULTURE = bageli RESULT = hindustani TIER = 1 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_hindustani_hindustani_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = hindustani CULTURE = hindustani }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_hindustani_hindustani_measured = yes }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_hindustani_avadhi_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = hindustani CULTURE = avadhi }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_hindustani_avadhi_measured = yes
				te_cmg_hindustani_avadhi_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_hindustani_bundeli_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = hindustani CULTURE = bundeli }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_hindustani_bundeli_measured = yes
				te_cmg_hindustani_bundeli_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_hindustani_chhattisgarhi_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = hindustani CULTURE = chhattisgarhi }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_hindustani_chhattisgarhi_measured = yes
				te_cmg_hindustani_chhattisgarhi_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_hindustani_bageli_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = hindustani CULTURE = bageli }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_hindustani_bageli_measured = yes
				te_cmg_hindustani_bageli_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 5 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_hindustani } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_hindustani value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_hindustani = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_hindustani value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_hindustani value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	te_cmg_hindustani_settle = yes
}

# Country scope. Joins every part of the hindustani merge that can join now and isn't waiting on a
# vanilla entry: when the merge starts, and each census while its starter holds it. Nothing joins once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33).
te_cmg_hindustani_join_ready = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_hindustani } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_hindustani_avadhi_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = hindustani CULTURE = avadhi INDEX = 23 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_hindustani_bundeli_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = hindustani CULTURE = bundeli INDEX = 23 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_hindustani_chhattisgarhi_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = hindustani CULTURE = chhattisgarhi INDEX = 23 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_hindustani_bageli_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = hindustani CULTURE = bageli INDEX = 23 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: the button's effect. The country starts the hindustani merge and brings in the parts it
# holds that qualify now. Only an idle merge starts: a second click on the same day finds it running.
te_cmg_start_hindustani = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_hindustani ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_hindustani ?= 2 } }
		te_cm_start_merge = { MERGE = hindustani RESULT = hindustani }
		te_cmg_hindustani_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Country scope: the tail of te_cmg_census_hindustani_country, run after the part gates are fresh.
# 1. A wait year, while the merge could start but a vanilla entry on a core part is open in any country (once a census,
#    up to te_cm_wait_cap_years).
# 2. The journal entry's net: an idle merge's candidate that can start, or a running merge's starter,
#    gets the entry back if it holds neither the active nor the inactive record (a rule switched off and on
#    prunes the inactive ones; a concluded entry is gone). It reads the entry's own gate and never adds one for
#    a complete merge, whose finished entry is its end. Merge mechanics never key on the entry.
# 3. Late joins: the starter of a running or complete merge brings in every part that now qualifies.
te_cmg_hindustani_settle = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			te_cm_system_enabled = yes
			NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_te_cm_hindustani }
			NOT = { has_inactive_journal_entry = je_te_cm_hindustani }
			OR = {
				te_cmg_hindustani_can_start = yes
				AND = {
					global_var:te_cm_state_hindustani ?= 1
					te_cmg_hindustani_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
		}
		add_journal_entry = { type = je_te_cm_hindustani }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_hindustani_is_starter = yes }
		te_cmg_hindustani_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_hindustani = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_hindustani ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_hindustani ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_hindustani_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_hindustani_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_hindustani }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_hindustani = {
			te_cmg_census_hindustani_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- dravidian ----

# Country scope: the candidate (or the running merge's starter). The dravidian result's average standard of
# living, pop-weighted, over its pops in the sphere's part of the core parts' homeland states (a state
# that is the homeland of several counts once). Sets te_cm_sg_ref, 0 when the result has no pops there.
# The reference an optional part is held against once no core part has a figure left; run only then.
te_cmg_dravidian_result_sol = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = te_cm_starter
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rsolw value = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { te_cm_in_sphere = yes }
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:tamil }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:kannada }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:malayalam }
				}
			}
			every_scope_pop = {
				limit = { culture = cu:cm_dravidian }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops add = total_size }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rsolw add = { value = standard_of_living multiply = total_size } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops >= 1 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = te_cm_sg_ref
			value = {
				value = local_var:te_cm_sg_rsolw
				divide = local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_dravidian, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_dravidian_<culture>, over the core range plus that part; with no core figure left, against the
# result's (walked only then, and only while an optional part has not switched, joined or not: the gate of a part
# that has joined must keep following the result, or one dip would freeze it for good).
te_cmg_census_dravidian_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tamil } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = dravidian CULTURE = tamil RESULT = cm_dravidian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_kannada } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = dravidian CULTURE = kannada RESULT = cm_dravidian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_malayalam } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = dravidian CULTURE = malayalam RESULT = cm_dravidian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_telegu } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = dravidian CULTURE = telegu RESULT = cm_dravidian TIER = 3 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_dravidian_tamil_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = dravidian CULTURE = tamil }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_dravidian_tamil_measured = yes
				te_cmg_dravidian_tamil_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_dravidian_kannada_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = dravidian CULTURE = kannada }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_dravidian_kannada_measured = yes
				te_cmg_dravidian_kannada_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_dravidian_malayalam_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = dravidian CULTURE = malayalam }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_dravidian_malayalam_measured = yes
				te_cmg_dravidian_malayalam_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 3 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_dravidian } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_dravidian value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_dravidian = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_dravidian value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_dravidian value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_ref value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:te_cm_sg_n = 0
			local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_telegu }
			}
		}
		te_cmg_dravidian_result_sol = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_telegu } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = dravidian CULTURE = telegu }
	}
	te_cmg_dravidian_settle = yes
}

# Country scope. Joins every part of the dravidian merge that can join now and isn't waiting on a
# vanilla entry: when the merge starts, and each census while its starter holds it. Nothing joins once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33).
te_cmg_dravidian_join_ready = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_dravidian } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_dravidian_tamil_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = dravidian CULTURE = tamil INDEX = 24 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_dravidian_kannada_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = dravidian CULTURE = kannada INDEX = 24 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_dravidian_malayalam_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = dravidian CULTURE = malayalam INDEX = 24 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_dravidian_telegu_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = dravidian CULTURE = telegu INDEX = 24 }
		}
	}
}

# ---- indonesian ----

# Country scope: the candidate (or the running merge's starter). The indonesian result's average standard of
# living, pop-weighted, over its pops in the sphere's part of the core parts' homeland states (a state
# that is the homeland of several counts once). Sets te_cm_sg_ref, 0 when the result has no pops there.
# The reference an optional part is held against once no core part has a figure left; run only then.

	save_temporary_scope_as = te_cm_starter
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rsolw value = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { te_cm_in_sphere = yes }
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:javan }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:malay }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:sumatran }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:bornean }
				}
			}
			every_scope_pop = {
				limit = { culture = cu:cm_indonesian }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops add = total_size }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rsolw add = { value = standard_of_living multiply = total_size } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops >= 1 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = te_cm_sg_ref
			value = {
				value = local_var:te_cm_sg_rsolw
				divide = local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_indonesian, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_indonesian_<culture>, over the core range plus that part; with no core figure left, against the
# result's (walked only then, and only while an optional part has not switched, joined or not: the gate of a part
# that has joined must keep following the result, or one dip would freeze it for good).
te_cmg_census_indonesian_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_javan } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = indonesian CULTURE = javan RESULT = cm_indonesian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_malay } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = indonesian CULTURE = malay RESULT = cm_indonesian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sumatran } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = indonesian CULTURE = sumatran RESULT = cm_indonesian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bornean } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = indonesian CULTURE = bornean RESULT = cm_indonesian TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_balinese } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = indonesian CULTURE = balinese RESULT = cm_indonesian TIER = 1 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_indonesian_javan_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = indonesian CULTURE = javan }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_indonesian_javan_measured = yes
				te_cmg_indonesian_javan_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_indonesian_malay_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = indonesian CULTURE = malay }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_indonesian_malay_measured = yes
				te_cmg_indonesian_malay_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_indonesian_sumatran_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = indonesian CULTURE = sumatran }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_indonesian_sumatran_measured = yes
				te_cmg_indonesian_sumatran_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_indonesian_bornean_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = indonesian CULTURE = bornean }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_indonesian_bornean_measured = yes
				te_cmg_indonesian_bornean_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 4 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_indonesian } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_indonesian value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_indonesian = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_indonesian value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_indonesian value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_ref value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:te_cm_sg_n = 0
			local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_balinese }
			}
		}
		te_cmg_indonesian_result_sol = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_balinese } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = indonesian CULTURE = balinese }
	}
	te_cmg_indonesian_settle = yes
}

# Country scope. Joins every part of the indonesian merge that can join now and isn't waiting on a
# vanilla entry: when the merge starts, and each census while its starter holds it. Nothing joins once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33).
te_cmg_indonesian_join_ready = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_indonesian } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_indonesian_javan_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = indonesian CULTURE = javan INDEX = 25 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_indonesian_malay_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = indonesian CULTURE = malay INDEX = 25 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_indonesian_sumatran_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = indonesian CULTURE = sumatran INDEX = 25 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_indonesian_bornean_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = indonesian CULTURE = bornean INDEX = 25 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_indonesian_balinese_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = indonesian CULTURE = balinese INDEX = 25 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: the button's effect. The country starts the indonesian merge and brings in the parts it
# holds that qualify now. Only an idle merge starts: a second click on the same day finds it running.
# Not once its result has switched into a wider culture (R36): that culture has gone, and a start would make it a
# primary culture again. The button's can_start says so too; this is the guard behind it.
te_cmg_start_indonesian = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_indonesian ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_indonesian ?= 2 }
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_indonesian }
		}
		te_cm_start_merge = { MERGE = indonesian RESULT = cm_indonesian }
		te_cmg_indonesian_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Country scope: the tail of te_cmg_census_indonesian_country, run after the part gates are fresh.
# 1. A wait year, while the merge could start but a vanilla entry on a core part is open in any country (once a census,
#    up to te_cm_wait_cap_years).
# 2. The journal entry's net: an idle merge's candidate that can start, or a running merge's starter,
#    gets the entry back if it holds neither the active nor the inactive record (a rule switched off and on
#    prunes the inactive ones; a concluded entry is gone). It reads the entry's own gate and never adds one for
#    a complete merge, whose finished entry is its end. Merge mechanics never key on the entry.
# 3. Late joins: the starter of a running or complete merge brings in every part that now qualifies.
te_cmg_indonesian_settle = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			te_cm_system_enabled = yes
			NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_te_cm_indonesian }
			NOT = { has_inactive_journal_entry = je_te_cm_indonesian }
			OR = {
				te_cmg_indonesian_can_start = yes
				AND = {
					global_var:te_cm_state_indonesian ?= 1
					te_cmg_indonesian_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
		}
		add_journal_entry = { type = je_te_cm_indonesian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_indonesian_is_starter = yes }
		te_cmg_indonesian_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_indonesian = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_indonesian ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_indonesian ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_indonesian_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_indonesian_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_indonesian }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_indonesian = {
			te_cmg_census_indonesian_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- filipino ----

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_filipino, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_filipino_<culture>, over the core range plus that part; with no core figure left, against the
# result's (walked only then, and only while an optional part has not switched, joined or not: the gate of a part
# that has joined must keep following the result, or one dip would freeze it for good).
te_cmg_census_filipino_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_filipino } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = filipino CULTURE = filipino RESULT = filipino TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_visayan } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = filipino CULTURE = visayan RESULT = filipino TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tagalog } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = filipino CULTURE = tagalog RESULT = filipino TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_ilocano } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = filipino CULTURE = ilocano RESULT = filipino TIER = 1 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_filipino_filipino_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = filipino CULTURE = filipino }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_filipino_filipino_measured = yes }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_filipino_visayan_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = filipino CULTURE = visayan }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_filipino_visayan_measured = yes
				te_cmg_filipino_visayan_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_filipino_tagalog_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = filipino CULTURE = tagalog }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_filipino_tagalog_measured = yes
				te_cmg_filipino_tagalog_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_filipino_ilocano_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = filipino CULTURE = ilocano }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_filipino_ilocano_measured = yes
				te_cmg_filipino_ilocano_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 4 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_filipino } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_filipino value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_filipino = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_filipino value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_filipino value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	te_cmg_filipino_settle = yes
}

# Country scope. Joins every part of the filipino merge that can join now and isn't waiting on a
# vanilla entry: when the merge starts, and each census while its starter holds it. Nothing joins once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33).
te_cmg_filipino_join_ready = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_filipino } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_filipino_visayan_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = filipino CULTURE = visayan INDEX = 26 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_filipino_tagalog_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = filipino CULTURE = tagalog INDEX = 26 }

				te_cmg_filipino_ilocano_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = filipino CULTURE = ilocano INDEX = 26 }
		}
	}
}

# ---- nguni ----

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_nguni, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_nguni_<culture>, over the core range plus that part; with no core figure left, against the
# result's (walked only then, and only while an optional part has not switched, joined or not: the gate of a part
# that has joined must keep following the result, or one dip would freeze it for good).
te_cmg_census_nguni_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_nguni } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = nguni CULTURE = nguni RESULT = cm_nguni TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_zulu } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = nguni CULTURE = zulu RESULT = cm_nguni TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_xhosa } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = nguni CULTURE = xhosa RESULT = cm_nguni TIER = 1 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_nguni_nguni_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = nguni CULTURE = nguni }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_nguni_nguni_measured = yes
				te_cmg_nguni_nguni_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_nguni_zulu_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = nguni CULTURE = zulu }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_nguni_zulu_measured = yes
				te_cmg_nguni_zulu_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_nguni_xhosa_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = nguni CULTURE = xhosa }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_nguni_xhosa_measured = yes
				te_cmg_nguni_xhosa_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 3 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_nguni } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_nguni value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_nguni = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_nguni value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_nguni value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	te_cmg_nguni_settle = yes
}

# ---- latin ----

# Country scope: the candidate (or the running merge's starter). The latin result's average standard of
# living, pop-weighted, over its pops in the sphere's part of the core parts' homeland states (a state
# that is the homeland of several counts once). Sets te_cm_sg_ref, 0 when the result has no pops there.
# The reference an optional part is held against once no core part has a figure left; run only then.
te_cmg_latin_result_sol = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = te_cm_starter
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rsolw value = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { te_cm_in_sphere = yes }
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:french }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:cm_italian }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:spanish }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:portuguese }
				}
			}
			every_scope_pop = {
				limit = { culture = cu:cm_latin }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops add = total_size }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rsolw add = { value = standard_of_living multiply = total_size } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops >= 1 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = te_cm_sg_ref
			value = {
				value = local_var:te_cm_sg_rsolw
				divide = local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_latin, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_latin_<culture>, over the core range plus that part; with no core figure left, against the
# result's (walked only then, and only while an optional part has not switched, joined or not: the gate of a part
# that has joined must keep following the result, or one dip would freeze it for good).
te_cmg_census_latin_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_french } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = french RESULT = cm_latin TIER = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_italian } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = cm_italian RESULT = cm_latin TIER = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_spanish } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = spanish RESULT = cm_latin TIER = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_portuguese } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = portuguese RESULT = cm_latin TIER = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_romanian } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = romanian RESULT = cm_latin TIER = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_platinean } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = platinean RESULT = cm_latin TIER = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_argentine } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = argentine RESULT = cm_latin TIER = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uruguayan } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = uruguayan RESULT = cm_latin TIER = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_chilean } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = chilean RESULT = cm_latin TIER = 2 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_latin_french_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = french }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_latin_french_measured = yes
				te_cmg_latin_french_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_latin_cm_italian_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = cm_italian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_latin_cm_italian_measured = yes
				te_cmg_latin_cm_italian_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_latin_spanish_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = spanish }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_latin_spanish_measured = yes
				te_cmg_latin_spanish_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_latin_portuguese_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = portuguese }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_latin_portuguese_measured = yes
				te_cmg_latin_portuguese_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 4 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_latin } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_latin value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_latin = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_latin value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_latin value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_ref value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:te_cm_sg_n = 0
			local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_romanian }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_platinean }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_argentine }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uruguayan }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_chilean }
			}
		}
		te_cmg_latin_result_sol = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_romanian } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = romanian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_platinean } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = platinean }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_argentine } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = argentine }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uruguayan } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = uruguayan }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_chilean } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = chilean }
	}
	te_cmg_latin_settle = yes
}

# Country scope. Joins every part of the latin merge that can join now and isn't waiting on a
# vanilla entry: when the merge starts, and each census while its starter holds it. Nothing joins once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33).
te_cmg_latin_join_ready = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_latin } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_latin_french_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = french INDEX = 28 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_latin_cm_italian_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = cm_italian INDEX = 28 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_latin_spanish_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = spanish INDEX = 28 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_latin_portuguese_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = portuguese INDEX = 28 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_latin_romanian_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = romanian INDEX = 28 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_latin_platinean_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = platinean INDEX = 28 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_latin_argentine_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = argentine INDEX = 28 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_latin_uruguayan_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = uruguayan INDEX = 28 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_latin_chilean_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = latin CULTURE = chilean INDEX = 28 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: the button's effect. The country starts the latin merge and brings in the parts it
# holds that qualify now. Only an idle merge starts: a second click on the same day finds it running.
te_cmg_start_latin = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_latin ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_latin ?= 2 } }
		te_cm_start_merge = { MERGE = latin RESULT = cm_latin }
		te_cmg_latin_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Country scope: the tail of te_cmg_census_latin_country, run after the part gates are fresh.
# 1. A wait year, while the merge could start but a vanilla entry on a core part is open in any country (once a census,
#    up to te_cm_wait_cap_years).
# 2. The journal entry's net: an idle merge's candidate that can start, or a running merge's starter,
#    gets the entry back if it holds neither the active nor the inactive record (a rule switched off and on
#    prunes the inactive ones; a concluded entry is gone). It reads the entry's own gate and never adds one for
#    a complete merge, whose finished entry is its end. Merge mechanics never key on the entry.
# 3. Late joins: the starter of a running or complete merge brings in every part that now qualifies.
te_cmg_latin_settle = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			te_cm_system_enabled = yes
			NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_te_cm_latin }
			NOT = { has_inactive_journal_entry = je_te_cm_latin }
			OR = {
				te_cmg_latin_can_start = yes
				AND = {
					global_var:te_cm_state_latin ?= 1
					te_cmg_latin_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
		}
		add_journal_entry = { type = je_te_cm_latin }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_latin_is_starter = yes }
		te_cmg_latin_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_latin = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_latin ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_latin ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_latin_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_latin_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_latin }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_latin = {
			te_cmg_census_latin_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- pan_slavic ----

# Country scope: the candidate (or the running merge's starter). The pan_slavic result's average standard of
# living, pop-weighted, over its pops in the sphere's part of the core parts' homeland states (a state
# that is the homeland of several counts once). Sets te_cm_sg_ref, 0 when the result has no pops there.
# The reference an optional part is held against once no core part has a figure left; run only then.
te_cmg_pan_slavic_result_sol = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = te_cm_starter
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rsolw value = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { te_cm_in_sphere = yes }
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:cm_east_slavic }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:cm_czechoslovak }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:cm_yugoslav }
				}
			}
			every_scope_pop = {
				limit = { culture = cu:cm_pan_slavic }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops add = total_size }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rsolw add = { value = standard_of_living multiply = total_size } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops >= 1 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = te_cm_sg_ref
			value = {
				value = local_var:te_cm_sg_rsolw
				divide = local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_pan_slavic, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_pan_slavic_<culture>, over the core range plus that part; with no core figure left, against the
# result's (walked only then, and only while an optional part has not switched, joined or not: the gate of a part
# that has joined must keep following the result, or one dip would freeze it for good).
te_cmg_census_pan_slavic_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_east_slavic } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = pan_slavic CULTURE = cm_east_slavic RESULT = cm_pan_slavic TIER = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_czechoslovak } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = pan_slavic CULTURE = cm_czechoslovak RESULT = cm_pan_slavic TIER = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_yugoslav } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = pan_slavic CULTURE = cm_yugoslav RESULT = cm_pan_slavic TIER = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_polish } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = pan_slavic CULTURE = polish RESULT = cm_pan_slavic TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_slovene } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = pan_slavic CULTURE = slovene RESULT = cm_pan_slavic TIER = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bulgarian } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = pan_slavic CULTURE = bulgarian RESULT = cm_pan_slavic TIER = 3 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = pan_slavic CULTURE = cm_east_slavic }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic_measured = yes
				te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_czechoslovak_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = pan_slavic CULTURE = cm_czechoslovak }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_czechoslovak_measured = yes
				te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_czechoslovak_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = pan_slavic CULTURE = cm_yugoslav }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav_measured = yes
				te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 3 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_pan_slavic } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_pan_slavic value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_pan_slavic = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_pan_slavic value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_pan_slavic value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_ref value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:te_cm_sg_n = 0
			local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_polish }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_slovene }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bulgarian }
			}
		}
		te_cmg_pan_slavic_result_sol = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_polish } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = pan_slavic CULTURE = polish }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_slovene } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = pan_slavic CULTURE = slovene }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bulgarian } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = pan_slavic CULTURE = bulgarian }
	}
	te_cmg_pan_slavic_settle = yes
}

# Country scope. Joins every part of the pan_slavic merge that can join now and isn't waiting on a
# vanilla entry: when the merge starts, and each census while its starter holds it. Nothing joins once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33).
te_cmg_pan_slavic_join_ready = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_pan_slavic } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_east_slavic_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = pan_slavic CULTURE = cm_east_slavic INDEX = 29 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_czechoslovak_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = pan_slavic CULTURE = cm_czechoslovak INDEX = 29 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_pan_slavic_cm_yugoslav_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = pan_slavic CULTURE = cm_yugoslav INDEX = 29 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_pan_slavic_polish_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = pan_slavic CULTURE = polish INDEX = 29 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_pan_slavic_slovene_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = pan_slavic CULTURE = slovene INDEX = 29 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_pan_slavic_bulgarian_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = pan_slavic CULTURE = bulgarian INDEX = 29 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: the button's effect. The country starts the pan_slavic merge and brings in the parts it
# holds that qualify now. Only an idle merge starts: a second click on the same day finds it running.
te_cmg_start_pan_slavic = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_pan_slavic ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_pan_slavic ?= 2 } }
		te_cm_start_merge = { MERGE = pan_slavic RESULT = cm_pan_slavic }
		te_cmg_pan_slavic_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Country scope: the tail of te_cmg_census_pan_slavic_country, run after the part gates are fresh.
# 1. A wait year, while the merge could start but a vanilla entry on a core part is open in any country (once a census,
#    up to te_cm_wait_cap_years).
# 2. The journal entry's net: an idle merge's candidate that can start, or a running merge's starter,
#    gets the entry back if it holds neither the active nor the inactive record (a rule switched off and on
#    prunes the inactive ones; a concluded entry is gone). It reads the entry's own gate and never adds one for
#    a complete merge, whose finished entry is its end. Merge mechanics never key on the entry.
# 3. Late joins: the starter of a running or complete merge brings in every part that now qualifies.
te_cmg_pan_slavic_settle = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			te_cm_system_enabled = yes
			NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_te_cm_pan_slavic }
			NOT = { has_inactive_journal_entry = je_te_cm_pan_slavic }
			OR = {
				te_cmg_pan_slavic_can_start = yes
				AND = {
					global_var:te_cm_state_pan_slavic ?= 1
					te_cmg_pan_slavic_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
		}
		add_journal_entry = { type = je_te_cm_pan_slavic }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_pan_slavic_is_starter = yes }
		te_cmg_pan_slavic_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_pan_slavic = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_pan_slavic ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_pan_slavic ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_pan_slavic_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_pan_slavic_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_slavic }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_slavic = {
			te_cmg_census_pan_slavic_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- pan_turkic ----

# Country scope: the candidate (or the running merge's starter). The pan_turkic result's average standard of
# living, pop-weighted, over its pops in the sphere's part of the core parts' homeland states (a state
# that is the homeland of several counts once). Sets te_cm_sg_ref, 0 when the result has no pops there.
# The reference an optional part is held against once no core part has a figure left; run only then.
te_cmg_pan_turkic_result_sol = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = te_cm_starter
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rsolw value = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { te_cm_in_sphere = yes }
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:cm_oghuz_turkic }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:uzbek }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:kazak }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:tatar }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:kirgiz }
				}
			}
			every_scope_pop = {
				limit = { culture = cu:cm_pan_turkic }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops add = total_size }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rsolw add = { value = standard_of_living multiply = total_size } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops >= 1 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = te_cm_sg_ref
			value = {
				value = local_var:te_cm_sg_rsolw
				divide = local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_pan_turkic, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_pan_turkic_<culture>, over the core range plus that part; with no core figure left, against the
# result's (walked only then, and only while an optional part has not switched, joined or not: the gate of a part
# that has joined must keep following the result, or one dip would freeze it for good).
te_cmg_census_pan_turkic_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_oghuz_turkic } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = cm_oghuz_turkic RESULT = cm_pan_turkic TIER = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uzbek } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = uzbek RESULT = cm_pan_turkic TIER = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_kazak } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = kazak RESULT = cm_pan_turkic TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_tatar } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = tatar RESULT = cm_pan_turkic TIER = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_kirgiz } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = kirgiz RESULT = cm_pan_turkic TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bashkir } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = bashkir RESULT = cm_pan_turkic TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_crimean_tatar } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = crimean_tatar RESULT = cm_pan_turkic TIER = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_caucasian_turk } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = caucasian_turk RESULT = cm_pan_turkic TIER = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uighur } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = uighur RESULT = cm_pan_turkic TIER = 2 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = cm_oghuz_turkic }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic_measured = yes
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_pan_turkic_uzbek_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = uzbek }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_uzbek_measured = yes
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_uzbek_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_pan_turkic_kazak_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = kazak }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_kazak_measured = yes
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_kazak_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_pan_turkic_tatar_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = tatar }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_tatar_measured = yes
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_tatar_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_pan_turkic_kirgiz_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = kirgiz }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_kirgiz_measured = yes
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_kirgiz_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 5 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_pan_turkic } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_pan_turkic value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_pan_turkic = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_pan_turkic value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_pan_turkic value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_ref value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:te_cm_sg_n = 0
			local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bashkir }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_crimean_tatar }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_caucasian_turk }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uighur }
			}
		}
		te_cmg_pan_turkic_result_sol = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_bashkir } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = bashkir }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_crimean_tatar } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = crimean_tatar }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_caucasian_turk } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = caucasian_turk }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_uighur } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = uighur }
	}
	te_cmg_pan_turkic_settle = yes
}

# Country scope. Joins every part of the pan_turkic merge that can join now and isn't waiting on a
# vanilla entry: when the merge starts, and each census while its starter holds it. Nothing joins once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33).
te_cmg_pan_turkic_join_ready = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_pan_turkic } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_cm_oghuz_turkic_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = cm_oghuz_turkic INDEX = 30 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_uzbek_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = uzbek INDEX = 30 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_kazak_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = kazak INDEX = 30 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_tatar_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = tatar INDEX = 30 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_kirgiz_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = kirgiz INDEX = 30 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_bashkir_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = bashkir INDEX = 30 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_crimean_tatar_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = crimean_tatar INDEX = 30 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_caucasian_turk_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = caucasian_turk INDEX = 30 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_uighur_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = pan_turkic CULTURE = uighur INDEX = 30 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: the button's effect. The country starts the pan_turkic merge and brings in the parts it
# holds that qualify now. Only an idle merge starts: a second click on the same day finds it running.
te_cmg_start_pan_turkic = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_pan_turkic ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_pan_turkic ?= 2 } }
		te_cm_start_merge = { MERGE = pan_turkic RESULT = cm_pan_turkic }
		te_cmg_pan_turkic_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Country scope: the tail of te_cmg_census_pan_turkic_country, run after the part gates are fresh.
# 1. A wait year, while the merge could start but a vanilla entry on a core part is open in any country (once a census,
#    up to te_cm_wait_cap_years).
# 2. The journal entry's net: an idle merge's candidate that can start, or a running merge's starter,
#    gets the entry back if it holds neither the active nor the inactive record (a rule switched off and on
#    prunes the inactive ones; a concluded entry is gone). It reads the entry's own gate and never adds one for
#    a complete merge, whose finished entry is its end. Merge mechanics never key on the entry.
# 3. Late joins: the starter of a running or complete merge brings in every part that now qualifies.
te_cmg_pan_turkic_settle = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			te_cm_system_enabled = yes
			NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_te_cm_pan_turkic }
			NOT = { has_inactive_journal_entry = je_te_cm_pan_turkic }
			OR = {
				te_cmg_pan_turkic_can_start = yes
				AND = {
					global_var:te_cm_state_pan_turkic ?= 1
					te_cmg_pan_turkic_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
		}
		add_journal_entry = { type = je_te_cm_pan_turkic }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_pan_turkic_is_starter = yes }
		te_cmg_pan_turkic_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_pan_turkic = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_pan_turkic ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_pan_turkic ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_pan_turkic_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_pan_turkic_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_turkic }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_turkic = {
			te_cmg_census_pan_turkic_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- pan_malay ----

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_pan_malay, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_pan_malay_<culture>, over the core range plus that part; with no core figure left, against the
# result's (walked only then, and only while an optional part has not switched, joined or not: the gate of a part
# that has joined must keep following the result, or one dip would freeze it for good).
te_cmg_census_pan_malay_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_indonesian } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = pan_malay CULTURE = cm_indonesian RESULT = cm_pan_malay TIER = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_filipino } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = pan_malay CULTURE = filipino RESULT = cm_pan_malay TIER = 3 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = pan_malay CULTURE = cm_indonesian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_measured = yes
				te_cmg_pan_malay_cm_indonesian_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = pan_malay CULTURE = filipino }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_measured = yes
				te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 2 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_pan_malay } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_pan_malay value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_pan_malay = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_pan_malay value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_pan_malay value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	te_cmg_pan_malay_settle = yes
}

# Country scope. Joins every part of the pan_malay merge that can join now and isn't waiting on a
# vanilla entry: when the merge starts, and each census while its starter holds it. Nothing joins once the

te_cmg_pan_malay_join_ready = {

			limit = {
				te_cmg_pan_malay_filipino_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = pan_malay CULTURE = filipino INDEX = 31 }
		}
	}
}

		te_cm_start_merge = { MERGE = pan_malay RESULT = cm_pan_malay }
		te_cmg_pan_malay_join_ready = yes
	}

# 1. A wait year, while the merge could start but a vanilla entry on a core part is open in any country (once a census,
#    up to te_cm_wait_cap_years).
# 2. The journal entry's net: an idle merge's candidate that can start, or a running merge's starter,
#    gets the entry back if it holds neither the active nor the inactive record (a rule switched off and on
#    prunes the inactive ones; a concluded entry is gone). It reads the entry's own gate and never adds one for
#    a complete merge, whose finished entry is its end. Merge mechanics never key on the entry.
# 3. Late joins: the starter of a running or complete merge brings in every part that now qualifies.
te_cmg_pan_malay_settle = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			te_cm_system_enabled = yes
			NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_te_cm_pan_malay }
			NOT = { has_inactive_journal_entry = je_te_cm_pan_malay }
			OR = {
				te_cmg_pan_malay_can_start = yes
				AND = {
					global_var:te_cm_state_pan_malay ?= 1
					te_cmg_pan_malay_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
		}
		add_journal_entry = { type = je_te_cm_pan_malay }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_pan_malay_is_starter = yes }
		te_cmg_pan_malay_join_ready = yes
	}
}

		every_country = {

		}
	}
