		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_malay }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_pan_malay = {
			te_cmg_census_pan_malay_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- east_african ----

# Country scope: the candidate (or the running merge's starter). The east_african result's average standard of
# living, pop-weighted, over its pops in the sphere's part of the core parts' homeland states (a state
# that is the homeland of several counts once). Sets te_cm_sg_ref, 0 when the result has no pops there.
# The reference an optional part is held against once no core part has a figure left; run only then.
te_cmg_east_african_result_sol = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = te_cm_starter
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rsolw value = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { te_cm_in_sphere = yes }
		every_scope_state = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:swahili }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:nyamwezi }
					state_region = { is_homeland = cu:sukuma }
				}
			}
			every_scope_pop = {
				limit = { culture = cu:cm_east_african }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rpops add = total_size }
				change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_rsolw add = { value = standard_of_living multiply = total_size } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops >= 1 }
		set_local_variable = {
			name = te_cm_sg_ref
			value = {
				value = local_var:te_cm_sg_rsolw
				divide = local_var:te_cm_sg_rpops
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: one candidate (or the running merge's starter). Measures every part that hasn't
# switched, then the standard-of-living gap over the core parts, te_cm_sol_ok_east_african, with hysteresis:
# it closes above te_cm_sol_gap_close and reopens below te_cm_sol_gap_open, and opens only while every
# core slot is met (has a figure, or joined and switched). Each optional part then gets its own gate,
# te_cm_sol_ok_east_african_<culture>, over the core range plus that part; with no core figure left, against the
# result's (walked only then, and only while an optional part has not switched, joined or not: the gate of a part
# that has joined must keep following the result, or one dip would freeze it for good).
te_cmg_census_east_african_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_swahili } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = swahili RESULT = cm_east_african TIER = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_nyamwezi } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = nyamwezi RESULT = cm_east_african TIER = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_sukuma } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = sukuma RESULT = cm_east_african TIER = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yao } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = yao RESULT = cm_east_african TIER = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_makua } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = makua RESULT = cm_east_african TIER = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_lacustrine_bantu } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = lacustrine_bantu RESULT = cm_east_african TIER = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_kikuyu } }
		te_cm_census_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = kikuyu RESULT = cm_east_african TIER = 3 }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_min value = 999 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_max value = -1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_n value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_east_african_swahili_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = swahili }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_east_african_swahili_measured = yes
				te_cmg_east_african_swahili_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_east_african_nyamwezi_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = nyamwezi }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_east_african_nyamwezi_measured = yes
				te_cmg_east_african_nyamwezi_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_east_african_sukuma_measured = yes }
		te_cm_sol_track = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = sukuma }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				te_cmg_east_african_sukuma_measured = yes
				te_cmg_east_african_sukuma_switched_in = yes
			}
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_slots add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_slots = 3 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_all value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_cm_sol_ok_east_african } }
		set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_east_african value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_n > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap value = local_var:te_cm_sg_max }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_gap subtract = local_var:te_cm_sg_min }
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_cm_sol_ok_east_african = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_cm_sg_gap > te_cm_sol_gap_close }
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_east_african value = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					local_var:te_cm_sg_gap < te_cm_sol_gap_open
					local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
				}
				set_variable = { name = te_cm_sol_ok_east_african value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_cm_sg_ref value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:te_cm_sg_n = 0
			local_var:te_cm_sg_all = 1
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yao }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_makua }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_lacustrine_bantu }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_kikuyu }
			}
		}
		te_cmg_east_african_result_sol = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_yao } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = yao }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_makua } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = makua }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_lacustrine_bantu } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = lacustrine_bantu }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_kikuyu } }
		te_cm_sol_gate_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = kikuyu }
	}
	te_cmg_east_african_settle = yes
}

# Country scope. Joins every part of the east_african merge that can join now and isn't waiting on a
# vanilla entry: when the merge starts, and each census while its starter holds it. Nothing joins once the
# merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33).
te_cmg_east_african_join_ready = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_east_african } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_east_african_swahili_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = swahili INDEX = 32 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_east_african_nyamwezi_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = nyamwezi INDEX = 32 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_east_african_sukuma_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = sukuma INDEX = 32 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_east_african_yao_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = yao INDEX = 32 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_east_african_makua_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = makua INDEX = 32 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_east_african_lacustrine_bantu_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = lacustrine_bantu INDEX = 32 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				te_cmg_east_african_kikuyu_can_join = yes
			}
			te_cm_join_part = { MERGE = east_african CULTURE = kikuyu INDEX = 32 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope: the button's effect. The country starts the east_african merge and brings in the parts it
# holds that qualify now. Only an idle merge starts: a second click on the same day finds it running.
te_cmg_start_east_african = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_east_african ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_east_african ?= 2 } }
		te_cm_start_merge = { MERGE = east_african RESULT = cm_east_african }
		te_cmg_east_african_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Country scope: the tail of te_cmg_census_east_african_country, run after the part gates are fresh.
# 1. A wait year, while the merge could start but a vanilla entry on a core part is open in any country (once a census,
#    up to te_cm_wait_cap_years).
# 2. The journal entry's net: an idle merge's candidate that can start, or a running merge's starter,
#    gets the entry back if it holds neither the active nor the inactive record (a rule switched off and on
#    prunes the inactive ones; a concluded entry is gone). It reads the entry's own gate and never adds one for
#    a complete merge, whose finished entry is its end. Merge mechanics never key on the entry.
# 3. Late joins: the starter of a running or complete merge brings in every part that now qualifies.
te_cmg_east_african_settle = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			te_cm_system_enabled = yes
			NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_te_cm_east_african }
			NOT = { has_inactive_journal_entry = je_te_cm_east_african }
			OR = {
				te_cmg_east_african_can_start = yes
				AND = {
					global_var:te_cm_state_east_african ?= 1
					te_cmg_east_african_is_starter = yes
				}
			}
		}
		add_journal_entry = { type = je_te_cm_east_african }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_cmg_east_african_is_starter = yes }
		te_cmg_east_african_join_ready = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. An idle merge: every country that can start it. A running or complete one: only its
# starter, so a part that comes up late can still join.
te_cmg_census_east_african = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOR = { global_var:te_cm_state_east_african ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_east_african ?= 2 } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { te_cmg_east_african_is_candidate = yes }
			te_cmg_census_east_african_country = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_east_african }
		global_var:te_cm_starter_east_african = {
			te_cmg_census_east_african_country = yes
		}
	}
}

# ---- All merges ----

# Any scope. A merge whose starter no longer exists, or is no longer a living country, is picked up by the
# country that carries te_cm_started_<m> (a civil war's winner inherits the loser's variables and continues the
# nation): the first such living country becomes the starter. Only a running merge with no such country goes
# back to idle (te_cm_release_starter), so another country can start it. Run first by te_cm_yearly_on_action.
te_cmg_release_lost_starters = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 2
			}
			te_cmg_german_starter_gone = yes
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				has_variable = te_cm_started_german
			}
			if = {
				limit = { te_cmg_german_starter_gone = yes }
				set_global_variable = { name = te_cm_starter_german value = this }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 1
			te_cmg_german_starter_gone = yes
		}
		te_cm_release_starter = { MERGE = german }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_italian ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_italian ?= 2
			}
			te_cmg_italian_starter_gone = yes
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				has_variable = te_cm_started_italian
			}
			if = {
				limit = { te_cmg_italian_starter_gone = yes }
				set_global_variable = { name = te_cm_starter_italian value = this }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:te_cm_state_italian ?= 1
			te_cmg_italian_starter_gone = yes
		}
		te_cm_release_starter = { MERGE = italian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_scandinavian ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_scandinavian ?= 2
			}
			te_cmg_scandinavian_starter_gone = yes
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				has_variable = te_cm_started_scandinavian
			}
			if = {
				limit = { te_cmg_scandinavian_starter_gone = yes }
				set_global_variable = { name = te_cm_starter_scandinavian value = this }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:te_cm_state_scandinavian ?= 1
			te_cmg_scandinavian_starter_gone = yes
		}
		te_cm_release_starter = { MERGE = scandinavian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_east_slavic ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_east_slavic ?= 2
			}
			te_cmg_east_slavic_starter_gone = yes
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				has_variable = te_cm_started_east_slavic
			}
			if = {
				limit = { te_cmg_east_slavic_starter_gone = yes }
				set_global_variable = { name = te_cm_starter_east_slavic value = this }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:te_cm_state_east_slavic ?= 1
			te_cmg_east_slavic_starter_gone = yes
		}
		te_cm_release_starter = { MERGE = east_slavic }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_yugoslav ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_yugoslav ?= 2
			}
			te_cmg_yugoslav_starter_gone = yes
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				has_variable = te_cm_started_yugoslav
			}
			if = {
				limit = { te_cmg_yugoslav_starter_gone = yes }
				set_global_variable = { name = te_cm_starter_yugoslav value = this }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:te_cm_state_yugoslav ?= 1
			te_cmg_yugoslav_starter_gone = yes
		}
		te_cm_release_starter = { MERGE = yugoslav }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_czechoslovak ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_czechoslovak ?= 2
			}
			te_cmg_czechoslovak_starter_gone = yes
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				has_variable = te_cm_started_czechoslovak
			}
			if = {
				limit = { te_cmg_czechoslovak_starter_gone = yes }
				set_global_variable = { name = te_cm_starter_czechoslovak value = this }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:te_cm_state_czechoslovak ?= 1
			te_cmg_czechoslovak_starter_gone = yes
		}
		te_cm_release_starter = { MERGE = czechoslovak }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_hungarian ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_hungarian ?= 2
			}
			te_cmg_hungarian_starter_gone = yes
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				has_variable = te_cm_started_hungarian
			}
			if = {
				limit = { te_cmg_hungarian_starter_gone = yes }
				set_global_variable = { name = te_cm_starter_hungarian value = this }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:te_cm_state_hungarian ?= 1
			te_cmg_hungarian_starter_gone = yes
		}
		te_cm_release_starter = { MERGE = hungarian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_dutch ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_dutch ?= 2
			}
			te_cmg_dutch_starter_gone = yes
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				has_variable = te_cm_started_dutch
			}
			if = {
				limit = { te_cmg_dutch_starter_gone = yes }
				set_global_variable = { name = te_cm_starter_dutch value = this }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:te_cm_state_dutch ?= 1
			te_cmg_dutch_starter_gone = yes
		}
		te_cm_release_starter = { MERGE = dutch }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_finnish ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_finnish ?= 2
			}
			te_cmg_finnish_starter_gone = yes
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				has_variable = te_cm_started_finnish
			}
			if = {
				limit = { te_cmg_finnish_starter_gone = yes }
				set_global_variable = { name = te_cm_starter_finnish value = this }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:te_cm_state_finnish ?= 1
			te_cmg_finnish_starter_gone = yes
		}
		te_cm_release_starter = { MERGE = finnish }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_french ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_french ?= 2
			}
			te_cmg_french_starter_gone = yes
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				has_variable = te_cm_started_french
			}
			if = {
				limit = { te_cmg_french_starter_gone = yes }
				set_global_variable = { name = te_cm_starter_french value = this }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:te_cm_state_french ?= 1
			te_cmg_french_starter_gone = yes
		}
		te_cm_release_starter = { MERGE = french }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_british ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_british ?= 2
			}
			te_cmg_british_starter_gone = yes
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				has_variable = te_cm_started_british
			}
			if = {
				limit = { te_cmg_british_starter_gone = yes }
				set_global_variable = { name = te_cm_starter_british value = this }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:te_cm_state_british ?= 1
			te_cmg_british_starter_gone = yes
		}
		te_cm_release_starter = { MERGE = british }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_american ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_american ?= 2
			}
			te_cmg_american_starter_gone = yes
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				has_variable = te_cm_started_american
			}
			if = {
				limit = { te_cmg_american_starter_gone = yes }
				set_global_variable = { name = te_cm_starter_american value = this }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:te_cm_state_american ?= 1
			te_cmg_american_starter_gone = yes
		}
		te_cm_release_starter = { MERGE = american }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_anglophone ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_anglophone ?= 2
			}
			te_cmg_anglophone_starter_gone = yes
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				has_variable = te_cm_started_anglophone
			}
			if = {

# Any scope. Measures every culture of a merge that is worth censusing, once, then runs each
# merge's census. A culture that has switched is skipped; one that has joined a merge is walked
# together with that merge's result (te_cm_census_culture_joined), the others alone. Called from
# te_cm_yearly_on_action behind the rule, the year and the 330-day lock.
te_cmg_census_all = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_german }
			te_cmg_german_census_wanted = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:te_cm_joined_german_north_german ?= 1 }
			te_cm_census_culture_joined = { CULTURE = north_german RESULT = cm_german }
		}
		else = {
			te_cm_census_culture = { CULTURE = north_german }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_south_german }
			te_cmg_german_census_wanted = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:te_cm_joined_german_south_german ?= 1 }
			te_cm_census_culture_joined = { CULTURE = south_german RESULT = cm_german }
		}
		else = {
			te_cm_census_culture = { CULTURE = south_german }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_alemannic }
			te_cmg_german_census_wanted = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:te_cm_joined_german_alemannic ?= 1 }
			te_cm_census_culture_joined = { CULTURE = alemannic RESULT = cm_german }
		}
		else = {
			te_cm_census_culture = { CULTURE = alemannic }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_east_german }
			te_cmg_german_census_wanted = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:te_cm_joined_german_east_german ?= 1 }
			te_cm_census_culture_joined = { CULTURE = east_german RESULT = cm_german }
		}
		else = {
			te_cm_census_culture = { CULTURE = east_german }
		}
	}
	if = {

		}
		if = {

	if = {

	if = {

# ---- Conversion, the switch and the primary cultures ----

# Country scope. This country's own yearly pulse (te_cm_yearly_on_action, behind the rule, not behind the census's
# year guard): for each running or complete merge whose starter is alive and has this country in its sphere, every
# part that joined and has not switched converts here (te_cm_convert_part). The starter is saved before the sphere
# test reads it: a scope left over from the census in the same on_action may hold another country.
# - While the merge runs (state 1), the whole merge stalls when its starter fails te_cmg_<m>_core_ok or
#   te_cm_sol_ok_<m>: both cover the core cultures only. A complete merge has no core part left to stall it.
# - Nothing converts once the merge's own result has switched into a higher merge's (R33).
# - One part stalls on its own gates, read on the starter: te_cm_ok_<m>_<c> (the hold alone, once joined: R29) and,
#   for an optional part, its own standard-of-living gate te_cm_sol_ok_<m>_<c> (R23). Progress is kept while stalled.
te_cmg_yearly_country = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_german
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_german }
		}
		global_var:te_cm_starter_german = { save_temporary_scope_as = te_cm_starter }
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:te_cm_starter = { is_country_alive = yes }
				te_cm_in_sphere = yes
				OR = {
					global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 2
					scope:te_cm_starter = {
						te_cmg_german_core_ok = yes
						var:te_cm_sol_ok_german ?= 1
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					global_var:te_cm_joined_german_north_german ?= 1
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_german }
					scope:te_cm_starter = {
						var:te_cm_ok_german_north_german ?= 1
					}
				}
				te_cm_convert_part = { MERGE = german CULTURE = north_german RESULT = cm_german TIER = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					global_var:te_cm_joined_german_south_german ?= 1
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_south_german }
					scope:te_cm_starter = {
						var:te_cm_ok_german_south_german ?= 1
					}
				}
				te_cm_convert_part = { MERGE = german CULTURE = south_german RESULT = cm_german TIER = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					global_var:te_cm_joined_german_alemannic ?= 1
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_alemannic }
					scope:te_cm_starter = {
						var:te_cm_ok_german_alemannic ?= 1
						var:te_cm_sol_ok_german_alemannic ?= 1
					}
				}
				te_cm_convert_part = { MERGE = german CULTURE = alemannic RESULT = cm_german TIER = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					global_var:te_cm_joined_german_east_german ?= 1
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_east_german }
					scope:te_cm_starter = {
						var:te_cm_ok_german_east_german ?= 1
						var:te_cm_sol_ok_german_east_german ?= 1
					}
				}
				te_cm_convert_part = { MERGE = german CULTURE = east_german RESULT = cm_german TIER = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_italian ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_italian ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_italian
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_italian }
		}
		global_var:te_cm_starter_italian = { save_temporary_scope_as = te_cm_starter }
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:te_cm_starter = { is_country_alive = yes }
				te_cm_in_sphere = yes
				OR = {
					global_var:te_cm_state_italian ?= 2
					scope:te_cm_starter = {
						te_cmg_italian_core_ok = yes
						var:te_cm_sol_ok_italian ?= 1
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					global_var:te_cm_joined_italian_north_italian ?= 1
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_italian }
					scope:te_cm_starter = {
						var:te_cm_ok_italian_north_italian ?= 1
					}
				}
				te_cm_convert_part = { MERGE = italian CULTURE = north_italian RESULT = cm_italian TIER = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					global_var:te_cm_joined_italian_south_italian ?= 1
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_south_italian }
					scope:te_cm_starter = {
						var:te_cm_ok_italian_south_italian ?= 1
					}
				}
				te_cm_convert_part = { MERGE = italian CULTURE = south_italian RESULT = cm_italian TIER = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					global_var:te_cm_joined_italian_corsican ?= 1
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_corsican }
					scope:te_cm_starter = {
						var:te_cm_ok_italian_corsican ?= 1
						var:te_cm_sol_ok_italian_corsican ?= 1
					}
				}
				te_cm_convert_part = { MERGE = italian CULTURE = corsican RESULT = cm_italian TIER = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_scandinavian ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_scandinavian ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_scandinavian
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_scandinavian }
		}
		global_var:te_cm_starter_scandinavian = { save_temporary_scope_as = te_cm_starter }
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:te_cm_starter = { is_country_alive = yes }
				te_cm_in_sphere = yes
				OR = {
					global_var:te_cm_state_scandinavian ?= 2
					scope:te_cm_starter = {
						te_cmg_scandinavian_core_ok = yes
						var:te_cm_sol_ok_scandinavian ?= 1
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					global_var:te_cm_joined_scandinavian_swedish ?= 1
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_swedish }
					scope:te_cm_starter = {
						var:te_cm_ok_scandinavian_swedish ?= 1
					}
				}
				te_cm_convert_part = { MERGE = scandinavian CULTURE = swedish RESULT = cm_scandinavian TIER = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					global_var:te_cm_joined_scandinavian_danish ?= 1
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_danish }
					scope:te_cm_starter = {
						var:te_cm_ok_scandinavian_danish ?= 1
					}
				}
				te_cm_convert_part = { MERGE = scandinavian CULTURE = danish RESULT = cm_scandinavian TIER = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					global_var:te_cm_joined_scandinavian_norwegian ?= 1
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_norwegian }
					scope:te_cm_starter = {
						var:te_cm_ok_scandinavian_norwegian ?= 1
					}
				}
				te_cm_convert_part = { MERGE = scandinavian CULTURE = norwegian RESULT = cm_scandinavian TIER = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					global_var:te_cm_joined_scandinavian_icelandic ?= 1
					NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_icelandic }
					scope:te_cm_starter = {
						var:te_cm_ok_scandinavian_icelandic ?= 1
						var:te_cm_sol_ok_scandinavian_icelandic ?= 1
					}
				}
				te_cm_convert_part = { MERGE = scandinavian CULTURE = icelandic RESULT = cm_scandinavian TIER = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_east_slavic ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_east_slavic ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_east_slavic
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_east_slavic }
		}
		global_var:te_cm_starter_east_slavic = { save_temporary_scope_as = te_cm_starter }
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:te_cm_starter = { is_country_alive = yes }
				te_cm_in_sphere = yes
				OR = {
					global_var:te_cm_state_east_slavic ?= 2
					scope:te_cm_starter = {
						te_cmg_east_slavic_core_ok = yes
						var:te_cm_sol_ok_east_slavic ?= 1
					}
				}
			}

# Any scope. Run by te_cm_yearly_on_action at the end of the census, behind the rule, the year and the lock: the
# dominance of every part that joined a running or complete merge and has not switched (te_cm_census_dominance reads
# the census's figures, no walk of its own), then the switch of each part at or over te_cm_switch_share. Only for a
# merge whose starter is alive (a dead one's census wasn't taken) and whose own result has not switched into a higher
# merge's (R33). Debug targets call it on its own.
te_cmg_dominance_all = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 2
			}
			NOT = { te_cmg_german_starter_gone = yes }
			NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_cm_german }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_german_north_german ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_german }
			}
			te_cm_census_dominance = { MERGE = german CULTURE = north_german }
			te_cm_switch_part = { MERGE = german CULTURE = north_german RESULT = cm_german }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_german_south_german ?= 1
				NOT = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_south_german }
			}
			te_cm_census_dominance = { MERGE = german CULTURE = south_german }
			te_cm_switch_part = { MERGE = german CULTURE = south_german RESULT = cm_german }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:te_cm_joined_german_alemannic ?= 1

			te_cm_census_dominance = { MERGE = german CULTURE = alemannic }

		if = {
			limit = {

			}

# Country scope. Run monthly (on_monthly_pulse_country, behind the rule) and by te_cmg_formed_country: for every
# culture that has switched, the result becomes a primary culture where the part is one, and pops of the part that
# came back convert (te_cm_monthly_switched_culture). One variable check per culture while nothing has switched.
te_cmg_monthly_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_german }
		te_cm_monthly_switched_culture = { CULTURE = north_german }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_south_german }
		te_cm_monthly_switched_culture = { CULTURE = south_german }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_alemannic }
		te_cm_monthly_switched_culture = { CULTURE = alemannic }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_east_german }
		te_cm_monthly_switched_culture = { CULTURE = east_german }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_north_italian }
		te_cm_monthly_switched_culture = { CULTURE = north_italian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_south_italian }
		te_cm_monthly_switched_culture = { CULTURE = south_italian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_corsican }
		te_cm_monthly_switched_culture = { CULTURE = corsican }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_swedish }
		te_cm_monthly_switched_culture = { CULTURE = swedish }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_cm_switched_danish }
		te_cm_monthly_switched_culture = { CULTURE = danish }
	}
	if = {

# Country scope = the newly formed country (on_country_formed, behind the rule). The monthly upkeep first, so a country
# formed from a definition that lists only parts gets the result at once. Then, for every running or complete merge whose
# starter has this country in its sphere and which has already converted here (te_cm_converted_<m>, set by
# te_cm_convert_part), the result as a primary culture if the formation dropped it, but only where a part that joined is
# primary here, as te_cm_convert_part gives it (R34); the starter, which carries te_cm_started_<m>, always qualifies.
te_cmg_formed_country = {
	te_cmg_monthly_country = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_german
			OR = {
				has_variable = te_cm_started_german
				AND = {
					has_variable = te_cm_converted_german
					OR = {
						AND = {
							global_var:te_cm_joined_german_north_german ?= 1
							country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_german
						}
						AND = {
							global_var:te_cm_joined_german_south_german ?= 1
							country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_german
						}
						AND = {
							global_var:te_cm_joined_german_alemannic ?= 1
							country_has_primary_culture = cu:alemannic
						}
						AND = {
							global_var:te_cm_joined_german_east_german ?= 1
							country_has_primary_culture = cu:east_german
						}
					}
				}
			}
			NOT = { country_has_primary_culture = cu:cm_german }
		}
		global_var:te_cm_starter_german = { save_temporary_scope_as = te_cm_starter }
		if = {
			limit = { te_cm_in_sphere = yes }
			add_primary_culture = cu:cm_german
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_italian ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_italian ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_italian
			OR = {
				has_variable = te_cm_started_italian
				AND = {
					has_variable = te_cm_converted_italian
					OR = {
						AND = {
							global_var:te_cm_joined_italian_north_italian ?= 1
							country_has_primary_culture = cu:north_italian
						}
						AND = {
							global_var:te_cm_joined_italian_south_italian ?= 1
							country_has_primary_culture = cu:south_italian
						}
						AND = {
							global_var:te_cm_joined_italian_corsican ?= 1
							country_has_primary_culture = cu:corsican
						}
					}
				}
			}
			NOT = { country_has_primary_culture = cu:cm_italian }
		}
		global_var:te_cm_starter_italian = { save_temporary_scope_as = te_cm_starter }
		if = {
			limit = { te_cm_in_sphere = yes }
			add_primary_culture = cu:cm_italian
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_scandinavian ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_scandinavian ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_scandinavian
			OR = {
				has_variable = te_cm_started_scandinavian
				AND = {
					has_variable = te_cm_converted_scandinavian
					OR = {
						AND = {
							global_var:te_cm_joined_scandinavian_swedish ?= 1
							country_has_primary_culture = cu:swedish
						}
						AND = {
							global_var:te_cm_joined_scandinavian_danish ?= 1
							country_has_primary_culture = cu:danish
						}
						AND = {
							global_var:te_cm_joined_scandinavian_norwegian ?= 1
							country_has_primary_culture = cu:norwegian
						}
						AND = {
							global_var:te_cm_joined_scandinavian_icelandic ?= 1
							country_has_primary_culture = cu:icelandic
						}
					}
				}
			}
			NOT = { country_has_primary_culture = cu:cm_scandinavian }
		}
		global_var:te_cm_starter_scandinavian = { save_temporary_scope_as = te_cm_starter }
		if = {
			limit = { te_cm_in_sphere = yes }
			add_primary_culture = cu:cm_scandinavian
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				global_var:te_cm_state_east_slavic ?= 1
				global_var:te_cm_state_east_slavic ?= 2
			}
			exists = global_var:te_cm_starter_east_slavic
			OR = {
				has_variable = te_cm_started_east_slavic
				AND = {
					has_variable = te_cm_converted_east_slavic
					OR = {
						AND = {
							global_var:te_cm_joined_east_slavic_russian ?= 1
							country_has_primary_culture = cu:russian
						}
						AND = {

# State region scope. Dynamic Homeland Progress has just removed the homeland of scope:te_cm_removed_culture here
# (te_homeland_removal_monthly_effect): the homeland of every part that switched into that culture goes with it, so an old
# homeland never outlives its successor. It follows the chain: a part that is itself a result (cm_italian into cm_latin,
# Corsican into cm_italian) takes the parts that switched into it with it, through te_cmg_remove_parts_of_<culture>.
# Not behind the rule: it is about map state.
te_cmg_remove_switched_part_homelands = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:te_cm_switched_north_german ?= scope:te_cm_removed_culture
			is_homeland = cu:north_german
		}
		remove_homeland = cu:north_german
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:te_cm_switched_south_german ?= scope:te_cm_removed_culture
			is_homeland = cu:south_german
		}
		remove_homeland = cu:south_german
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:te_cm_switched_alemannic ?= scope:te_cm_removed_culture
			is_homeland = cu:alemannic
		}
		remove_homeland = cu:alemannic
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:te_cm_switched_east_german ?= scope:te_cm_removed_culture
			is_homeland = cu:east_german
		}
		remove_homeland = cu:east_german
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:te_cm_switched_north_italian ?= scope:te_cm_removed_culture
			is_homeland = cu:north_italian
		}
		remove_homeland = cu:north_italian

# State region scope. The homeland of cm_italian has just been removed here: so is that of each part that switched into it,
# and, down the chain, of the parts that switched into those.
te_cmg_remove_parts_of_cm_italian = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:te_cm_switched_north_italian ?= cu:cm_italian
			is_homeland = cu:north_italian
		}
		remove_homeland = cu:north_italian
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:te_cm_switched_south_italian ?= cu:cm_italian
			is_homeland = cu:south_italian
		}
		remove_homeland = cu:south_italian
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:te_cm_switched_corsican ?= cu:cm_italian
			is_homeland = cu:corsican
		}
		remove_homeland = cu:corsican
	}
}

# State region scope. The homeland of cm_east_slavic has just been removed here: so is that of each part that switched into it,
# and, down the chain, of the parts that switched into those.
te_cmg_remove_parts_of_cm_east_slavic = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:te_cm_switched_russian ?= cu:cm_east_slavic
			is_homeland = cu:russian
		}
		remove_homeland = cu:russian
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:te_cm_switched_ukrainian ?= cu:cm_east_slavic
			is_homeland = cu:ukrainian
		}
		remove_homeland = cu:ukrainian
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:te_cm_switched_byelorussian ?= cu:cm_east_slavic
			is_homeland = cu:byelorussian
		}
		remove_homeland = cu:byelorussian
	}
}

	}

		}
		remove_homeland = cu:slovene
	}
	if = {

			is_homeland = cu:bulgarian
		}
		remove_homeland = cu:bulgarian
	}
}

# is a candidate for: te_cm_debug_dump_merge, then te_cm_debug_dump_part per slot culture a starter can bring in.

	if = {
		limit = { OR = { global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 1 global_var:te_cm_state_german ?= 2 te_cmg_german_is_candidate = yes } }
